blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 视觉特工通过放大到相关区域来回答关于超高分辨率相片的问题. 然而,现有的代理人往往从常识来回答而不是阅读证据. 在最终答案上的强化学习(RL)无法纠正这一点,因为猜测得到的奖励与阅读相同. 我们提出交叉输入相对政策优化(CrossRPO),对代理商进行对比集的培训. 一个对比集问了一个问题,一个图像的几个版本只与证据相去甚远,并且有不同的答案,所以只有读取证据才能解决整个集合. CrossRPO奖励解决整个集,我们证明它并没有强化一个集从常识中解答. 我们通过编辑21到120兆像素图像中的一个小物体来建立训练(VIRA-Train)和评价(VIRA-Bench)的对比集,我们用真实变化(VIRA-Bench-Real)进一步拍摄集,以排除编辑痕迹. 我们培训了两个视觉理性代理人,即VIRA-9B和VIRA-27B,其中CrossRPO只负责大约3500件VIRA-Train. CrossRPO在VIRA-Bench上达到63.3%的设定精度最高分辨率,而GRPO则为59.3%. VIRA-9B是其大小在所有基准上最准确的开放模型,而VIRA-27B的表现优于克洛德·海库·5.5和GPT-6-Luna,两者都处于最高思维水平,在大多数基准上都是如此.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Photos from modern cameras have tens of megapixels (MP), but the detail that answers a question about them is often only a few dozen pixels wide, such as what a pedestrian down the street is holding.
Such photos exceed the input size of vision-language models.
For example, Qwen3.5 turns each patch of 32 × 32 32\times 32 pixels into one token, so a 45 MP photo would require about 44,000 tokens.
Models therefore cap the input size, even with high-resolution encoders [ 39 , 22 , 3 , 61 ] , and shrink larger photos to fit.
The detail shrinks with the photo and often becomes unreadable [ 73 , 66 , 84 ] .
At the 3.8 MP limit of Claude Haiku 5.5, a detail 50 pixels wide in a 45 MP photo becomes about 15 pixels wide.
To recover such details, visual agents view the whole photo at low resolution and zoom into the regions they need [ 50 , 60 ] .
Some follow a fixed search procedure [ 57 , 35 , 82 , 67 , 40 , 41 ] , and others learn where to zoom [ 53 , 87 , 59 , 33 , 85 , 25 , 83 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
现代相机的照片有数十兆像素(MP),但是回答关于它们的一个问题的细节往往只有几十个像素宽,比如街下的行人所持有的像素.
这些照片超过了视觉语言模型的输入大小.
例如,Quen3.5将每块32×3232\时32像素的补丁变为一个符号,因此45张MP照片需要约44,000个符号.
因此,模型封顶了输入大小,即使有高分辨率编码器[39,22,3,61],并收缩更大的照片以适应.
细节随照片而收缩,并经常变得不可读[73,66,84].
在克劳德·海库5.5的3.8MP极限,45MP照片中一个细微的50像素宽度变为约15像素宽度.
为了找回这些细节,视觉特工以低分辨率查看整个照片,并放大到他们需要的区域[50,60].
有的遵循固定的搜索程序[57,35,82,67,40,41],有的学习放大何处[53,87,59,33,85,25,83,13].

blocks.en:
Correct without reading. However, a correct answer does not show that the agent read the evidence, because common sense often gives the same answer [ 1 , 49 , 64 , 38 , 19 , 75 ] .
For example, a person who holds up a small device as if taking a photo usually holds a smartphone.
An agent can therefore answer “smartphone” correctly without reading the device.
Figure a tests this with three versions of a 45 MP street photo, in which a woman holds up a smartphone, a calculator or a TV remote.
The device fits in a square of 110 pixels, so a model must zoom in to read it.
Without a zoom tool, Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna answer “smartphone” for all three versions.
The released agents DeepEyes [ 87 ] and ZoomEye [ 57 ] give the same answer, although they can zoom.
Even with a zoom tool and its highest thinking level, Claude Haiku 5.5 still identifies the remote as a smartphone.
Being able to zoom therefore does not make an agent read the evidence.
blocks.zh:
正确,不读。 然而,正确的答案并不表明代理人读取了证据,因为常识常常给出相同的答案[1,49,64,38,19,75].
例如,一个拿起一个小设备,就像拍照一样的人通常拿着一个智能手机.
因此,代理人可以正确回答“智能电话”,而不读取设备。
以45MP街机照片的三种版本来测试,其中女性持有智能手机,计算器或电视遥控器.
设备适合110像素的方形,所以一个模型必须放大读取.
没有缩放工具,Claude Haiku 5.5和GPT-6-Luna对所有三个版本都回答“智能手机”。
被释放的特工DeepEyes[87]和ZoomEye[57]给出了相同的答案,虽然可以放大.
即使有了缩放工具及其最高的思维水平,克劳德·海库·5.5仍然将远程识别为智能手机.
因此,能够放大并不使代理人阅读证据。

blocks.en:
Existing methods. The agents that learn where to zoom are trained with reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer [ 21 , 29 ] , typically with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 55 ] .
This training cannot correct the guess, because on a single image, a guess earns the same reward as reading.
The guess is also easier, because it requires no zoom, so it becomes a shortcut that the reward cannot detect [ 16 , 10 , 79 , 77 ] .
Recent work therefore also rewards the zoom, such as a tool call [ 87 ] , a crop that covers annotated evidence [ 86 , 11 ] or a call that improves the answer [ 51 , 14 ] .
These rewards credit viewing the evidence rather than reading it, and agents learn to call the zoom tool without using what it shows [ 25 , 69 , 90 , 47 ] .
For example, on the TV remote version of Figure a, DeepEyes zooms onto the whole remote but writes that “ the zoomed-in image confirms that the person is holding a smartphone. ”
Given only this zoom in a new conversation, it answers “ TV remote. ”
Other methods mask the evidence and reward abstention or penalize an answer [ 74 , 42 ] .
However, a masked image has no answer to read, so they cannot check whether the answer changes with the evidence.
Both still judge one image at a time.
blocks.zh:
现有方法。 学习何地放大的特工人员在最终答案[21,29]上接受强化学习(RL)培训,典型的是采用集团相对政策优化(GRPO)[55].
这种训练无法校正猜想,因为在单一的图像上,猜想得到的奖励与阅读一样.
猜测也比较容易,因为它不需要缩放,所以成为奖励无法发现的捷径[16,10,79,77].
因此,近期的工作也奖励了缩放,如工具调用[87],覆盖注释证据的作物[86,11]或改进答案的调用[51,14].
这些奖赏了观看证据而不是阅读证据的信用,特工们学会了不使用显示工具而拨打缩放工具[25,69,90,47].
例如,在电视远程版本的图a中,DeepEyes将缩放到整个远程上,但写道,“放大图像证实此人持有智能手机。 “
在新对话中,
其他方法掩盖证据,奖励弃权或惩罚答案[74、42]。
然而,一个蒙面图像没有可读的答案,因此他们无法检查答案是否随证据而改变.
两人仍然一次判断一个形象.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Examples of ViRA-Bench and ViRA-Bench-Real. Each set shows the original photo (O, cut to 16:9) with the object in a yellow box.
The insets show the object in O and the two variants (A, B), with the correct answers.
Below each set are the original’s answer and the number of baseline settings, out of 15 (Appendix D.1 ), that give this answer to all three versions at 1 MP.
Questions are shortened.
blocks.zh:
图1:VIRA-Bench和VIRA-Bench-Real的例子。 每集显示原照片(O,切为16:9),对象为黄色盒.
内置物以O和两个变体(A,B)显示对象,给出正确的答案.
每套下方是原始答案和基线设置的数目,在15个(附录D.1)中,所有三个版本都以1 MP给出这个答案.
问题被缩短。

blocks.en:
Contrast sets. On one image, reading and guessing give the same answer, so no reward on that image can separate them.
Several versions of the same photo can.
A contrast set [ 15 ] asks the same question about several versions of a photo.
Only a small region with the evidence differs between them, so the versions have different answers, as in Figure a.
An agent that gives the same answer to every version can be correct on only one of them, so only reading the evidence can solve the whole set.
We call the share of sets that an agent solves its set accuracy .
Contrast sets and similar minimal pairs have been used to evaluate vision-language models [ 17 , 63 , 34 ] and to train them with supervised losses [ 31 , 62 , 7 ] .
We build such sets for zoom agents by editing one small object in real photos of 21 to 120 MP.
ViRA-Train has 9,261 sets with K = 1 K=1 , 2 or 3 versions for training, and ViRA-Bench has 762 sets for evaluation.
In ViRA-Bench, the edited object covers a median of 0.0075% of the photo.
We also photograph 78 sets in which only the real object changes between shots (ViRA-Bench-Real), so they involve no editing.
Figure 1 shows examples of both benchmarks, on which many of the models we test give the same answer to all three versions.
blocks.zh:
对比点 在一个图像上,阅读和猜测给出了相同的答案,因此在图像上的任何奖励都无法将它们分开.
多个版本的相同照片罐.
对照集 [15] 对照片的多个版本提出了同样的问题.
只有一个小区域有它们之间的证据不同,所以版本有不同的答案,如图a.
一个给每个版本提供相同答案的代理只能对其中之一正确,所以只有读取证据才能解析整个集.
我们称之为一个代理解决其设定精度的套件份额。
对照装置和类似的最低配对被用于评价视觉语言模型[17、63、34],并培训其有监督的损失[31、62、7]。
我们通过编辑21到120 MP真实照片中的一个小对象, 来为缩放代理构建这样的设定。
VIRA-Train有9,261套,其中K=1K=1,2或3个版本用于培训,VIRA-Bench有762套用于评价.
在VIRA-Bench中,编辑对象覆盖了照片的中位数0.0075%.
我们还拍摄了78套,其中只有真实物体在镜头之间发生改变(Vira-Bench-Real),因此它们不涉及编辑.
图1显示了两个基准的例子,我们测试的许多模型对所有三个版本都给出了相同的答案。

blocks.en:
CrossRPO. GRPO samples several answers (rollouts) for one input and compares them with each other (Figure 2 , top).
If it trains on each version of a contrast set separately, no reward depends on solving the whole set.
If it compares rollouts across versions (pooled GRPO), a guess that is correct on one version scores above the wrong answers on the others and is rewarded.
We therefore propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO, Figure 2 , bottom).
It compares each rollout only with rollouts of the same version, so a guess that is always correct on one version receives no credit.
It then scales the result with a cross-input weight.
The weight grows when the other versions are answered correctly, because a correct answer on this version then solves the set.
CrossRPO applies to sets of any size, including single images, whereas recent methods for two inputs [ 27 , 89 , 91 , 37 , 12 ] handle only pairs.
We prove that its update is unbiased and does not reinforce a set answered from common sense, and that the objectives of GRPO and of these two-input methods are special cases of its objective.
blocks.zh:
十字军 GRPO对一个输入的几个答案(rollouts)进行了抽样,并相互比较(图2,顶部).
如果它在每个版本的对比度设置上分别进行训练,则不取决于解决整个设定的奖励.
如果它比较各版本的推出情况(拼凑的GRPO),则一个版本的得分高于其他版本的错误答案,这个猜测是正确的,并获得奖励.
因此,我们提议对交叉输入相对政策进行优化(CrossRPO,图2,下方)。
它只将每次推出与同一版本的推出相比较,所以一个版本上总是正确的猜测得不到任何信用.
然后以跨输入重量衡量结果。
当其他版本得到正确回答时,权重会增加,因为在这个版本上正确的答案然后解决集合.
CrossRPO适用于任何大小的组合,包括单一图像,而最近两种输入[27,89,91,37,12]的方法只处理对.
我们证明,其更新是无偏见的,没有强化从常识上回答的一套办法,而《全球资源规划》的目标和这两种投入方法是其目标的特殊情况。

blocks.en:
ViRA. With CrossRPO, we train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, on about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each.
With the same data and reward, CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO on each version separately and 52.6% for pooled GRPO.
Training on each version separately, without the cross-input weight, achieves 58.7%.
CrossRPO loses its gain over separate training when the cross-input weight comes from photos of other questions, so the gain depends on the contrast sets.
ViRA-9B zooms onto the object as often as the agent trained on each version separately, but it reads the object correctly more often.
ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B are the most accurate open agents of their sizes on ten and nine of the ten benchmarks we test, respectively.
On ViRA-Bench, ViRA-27B also outperforms all proprietary models we test at every resolution (Figure b).
blocks.zh:
与CrossRPO合作,我们培训了两名视觉理性特工,即VIRA-9B和VIRA-27B,每人约3500件VIRA-Train.
通过同样的数据和奖励,CrossRPO在VIRA-Bench上达到63.3%的精确度,而GRPO的精确度分别为59.3%和52.6%。
在没有交叉输入权的情况下,就每个版本分别进行培训,实现 58.7%.
CrossRPO在交叉输入权重来自其他问题的照片时,会因为单独的训练而失去收益,因此收益取决于对比集.
VIRA-9B对对象的放大频率与对每个版本的代理分别训练的频率一样,但它更经常地正确读取对象.
VIRA-9B和VIRA-27B是我们测试的10个基准中分别有10个基准和9个基准上最精确的其大小的开放剂.
在VIRA-Bench上,VIRA-27B也超越了我们在每个分辨率测试的所有专有模型(图b).

blocks.en: Contributions. Our contributions are as follows. • We propose CrossRPO, which trains on sets of inputs of any size. We prove that its update is unbiased, that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense, and that the objectives of GRPO and of recent two-input methods are special cases of its objective. • We build ViRA-Train and ViRA-Bench, contrast sets made by editing one small object in photos of 21 to 120 MP, and ViRA-Bench-Real, photographed sets in which only the real object changes. • We train ViRA-9B and 27B with CrossRPO. Our experiments show that ViRA models outperform the models with similar size on most benchmarks. We will release all data, code and models.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 • 我们的贡献如下。 我们建议CrossRPO, 训练各种大小的输入。 我们证明,它的更新是没有偏见的,它没有强化从常识上回答的一套办法,《全球资源规划》的目标和最近的双投入方法是其目标的特殊情况。 我们建造了VIRA-Train和VIRA-Bench,通过编辑21至120 MP照片中一个小对象而制作的对比集,以及VIRA-Bench-Real拍摄的只有真实对象变化的集合. ^ 我们用CrossRPO训练VIRA-9B和27B. 我们的实验显示,VIRA模型在大多数基准上都比模型大。 我们将发布所有的数据,代码和模型.

blocks.en: We propose CrossRPO, which trains on sets of inputs of any size. We prove that its update is unbiased, that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense, and that the objectives of GRPO and of recent two-input methods are special cases of its objective.
blocks.zh: 我们建议CrossRPO, 训练各种大小的输入。 我们证明,它的更新是没有偏见的,它没有强化从常识上回答的一套办法,《全球资源规划》的目标和最近的双投入方法是其目标的特殊情况。

blocks.en: We build ViRA-Train and ViRA-Bench, contrast sets made by editing one small object in photos of 21 to 120 MP, and ViRA-Bench-Real, photographed sets in which only the real object changes.
blocks.zh: 我们建造了VIRA-Train和VIRA-Bench,通过编辑21到120 MP照片中一个小对象而制作的对比集,以及VIRA-Bench-Real拍摄的只有真实对象改变的集合.

blocks.en: We train ViRA-9B and 27B with CrossRPO. Our experiments show that ViRA models outperform the models with similar size on most benchmarks. We will release all data, code and models.
blocks.zh: 我们用CrossRPO训练VIRA-9B和27B. 我们的实验显示,VIRA模型在大多数基准上都比模型大。 我们将发布所有的数据,代码和模型.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Zooming agents. Thinking-with-images agents [ 50 , 60 ] crop and zoom over several turns.
They are trained with supervised data [ 53 ] or with RL on the final answer [ 87 , 59 , 33 , 85 , 25 , 83 , 13 ] .
Other methods search the image without training [ 57 , 35 , 82 , 67 ] or learn to see fine details without zooming [ 70 , 81 ] .
Recent rewards credit crops that cover the evidence [ 86 , 11 ] or calls that outperform a random crop or no call [ 51 , 14 ] , but they still judge one image at a time.
Audits find that the returned crops often matter little [ 54 , 69 , 90 ] and that the gains come mostly from the model [ 47 ] .
Except for PerceptRL [ 20 ] , these works compare with proprietary models that view the image once and have no zoom tool [ 59 , 70 , 71 , 81 , 51 ] , whereas we give them our zoom tool at their highest thinking level.
blocks.zh:
放大剂。 思考 - 与图像的代理 [50,60] 作物和放大 几个转弯。
培训对象有受监督的数据[53]或最后答复的RL[87、59、33、85、25、83、13]。
其他方法在不经过训练的情况下搜索图像[57,35,82,67],或者学会在不放大的情况下看到细细的细节[70,81].
近期奖励的信用作物涵盖证据[86,11]或称其表现优于随机作物或没有呼叫[51,14],但他们仍然一次判断一个图像.
审计发现,退耕还林的作物往往没有多大作用[54,69,90],收益大多来自模型[47].
除了PerceptRL [20],这些作品与专有模型比较,这些模型曾经查看过图像,没有缩放工具[59,70,71,81,51],而我们则在最高思维水平上给他们我们的缩放工具.

blocks.en:
Learning from contrasts. Contrast sets and similar minimal pairs [ 17 , 15 , 63 , 34 ] test whether answers follow the image, and they credit a model only if it answers every member correctly.
Counterfactual examples also serve as supervised training data [ 31 , 62 , 7 ] .
For RL, a reward on the final answer cannot distinguish an answer that is read from the image from an answer that is based on priors [ 79 , 42 , 77 ] .
DeFacto [ 74 ] and EVAN [ 42 ] therefore add training signals from inputs without the evidence, whereas our versions replace the evidence, so every version has an answer to read.
GRPO [ 55 , 21 ] and its variants [ 2 , 44 , 80 , 88 ] compare rollouts of one prompt, also for vision-language models [ 26 , 56 , 45 , 68 ] .
Recent methods train on augmented or rephrased copies of an input with the same answer [ 43 , 91 , 89 , 76 ] , on counterfactual pairs [ 12 , 37 , 27 ] or on packs of inputs [ 30 , 28 ] .
CRPO [ 12 ] weights an input and its transformed copy by the accuracy on the other, and CrossRPO extends this coupling to any number of inputs (Appendix A.11 ).
blocks.zh:
学习对比。 对比集和相似的最小对 [17, 15, 63, 34] 测试答案是否跟随图像,它们只有在每个成员正确回答时才会信用一个模型.
反事实事例也作为监督培训数据[31、62、7]。
对RL来说,在最终答案上的奖励无法区分从图像读取的答案与基于前作的答案[79,42,77].
DeFacto [74] 和 EVAN [42] 因此添加了没有证据输入的训练信号,而我们的版本取代了证据,所以每个版本都有读取的答案.
GRPO [55, 21] 及其变体 [2, 44, 80, 88] 比较推出一个速率,也用于视觉语言模型 [26, 56, 45, 68].
最近的方法是用相同的答案对一个输入进行扩充或重写[43、91、89、76]、反事实对[12、37、27]或包输入[30、28]。
CRPO [12] 将输入及其变换的拷贝按其准确性加权,CrossRPO将这种耦合扩展到任何输入数(Appendix A.11 ).

blocks.en: 3 Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
blocks.zh: 3 交叉输入相对政策优化

blocks.en:
On a single image, a correct guess earns the same reward as reading, so RL on final answers cannot distinguish them.
A contrast set can distinguish them, because a guess is correct on only one of its versions.
CrossRPO turns this difference into a training signal for visual agents.
Figure 2 compares its pipeline with GRPO. The theorems, propositions and their proofs are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
在单一的图像上,一个正确的猜测获得与阅读相同的奖励,因此最终答案上的RL无法区分它们.
一个对比集可以区分它们,因为一个猜测只对一个版本是正确的.
CrossRPO将这种区别转化为视觉特工的训练信号.
图2将其管道与GPRO进行比较。 定理、命题及其证明载于附录A。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en:
Reward. The agent receives a question q q and an image s s downsampled to a pixel budget of x x MP.
At each turn, it either answers or calls a zoom tool with a box on the image.

blocks.en:
A contrast set [ 15 ] is a tuple 𝒮 = ( q , ( s v , y v ) v = 1 K ) \mathcal{S}=(q,(s_{v},y_{v})_{v=1}^{K}) of a question q q and K K versions s v s_{v} of an image with correct answers y v y_{v} .
The versions are identical except in a small region with the evidence, and y u ≠ y v y_{u}\neq y_{v} for u ≠ v u\neq v .
A single image is a set with K = 1 K=1 .
The agent sees one version at a time.
Let o v ∼ P θ ( ⋅ ∣ s v ) o_{v}\sim P_{\theta}(\cdot\mid s_{v}) be independent rollouts, one on each version, with c v = 𝟏 [ ans ( o v ) = y v ] c_{v}=\mathbf{1}[\mathrm{ans}(o_{v})=y_{v}] .
The agent solves the set if c 1 = ⋯ = c K = 1 c_{1}=\dots=c_{K}=1 .
The accuracy on version v v and the set accuracy are p v = Pr [ c v = 1 ] , Pr [ c 1 = ⋯ = c K = 1 ] = ∏ v p v . p_{v}=\Pr[c_{v}=1],\quad\Pr[c_{1}=\dots=c_{K}=1]=\prod_{v}p_{v}. (1) Consider an agent that does not read the region that differs.
Since the versions are identical outside this region, its answer has the same distribution on every version, ρ ( a ) = Pr [ ans ( o v ) = a ] \rho(a)=\Pr[\mathrm{ans}(o_{v})=a] for all v v , and hence p v = ρ ⁡ ( y v ) p_{v}=\rho(y_{v}) .
Since the y v y_{v} are pairwise different, ∑ v p v = ∑ v ρ ⁡ ( y v ) ≤ ∑ a ρ ⁡ ( a ) ≤ 1 \sum_{v}p_{v}=\sum_{v}\rho(y_{v})\leq\sum_{a}\rho(a)\leq 1 , and hence ∏ v p v ≤ ( 1 K ​ ∑ v p v ) K ≤ K − K \prod_{v}p_{v}\leq\big(\frac{1}{K}\sum_{v}p_{v}\big)^{K}\leq K^{-K} (Proposition A.11 ).
If the agent always gives the same answer and K ≥ 2 K\geq 2 , then ∏ v p v = 0 \prod_{v}p_{v}=0 .
In contrast, an agent that reads can reach p v = 1 p_{v}=1 for all v v and ∏ v p v = 1 \prod_{v}p_{v}=1 .
Set accuracy alone gives a weak signal early in training.
The term of version v v in its gradient is ∏ u ≠ v p u ​ ∇ θ p v \prod_{u\neq v}p_{u}\nabla_{\theta}p_{v} , which is zero when another version is never answered correctly.

blocks.en: 4 ViRA-Bench and ViRA-Train
blocks.zh: 4架VIRA-Bench和VIRA-Train

blocks.en:
CrossRPO requires sets whose versions differ only in the evidence and have different correct answers.
This section introduces three datasets of such sets, ViRA-Bench, ViRA-Bench-Real and ViRA-Train, which are built from ultra-high-resolution photos of 21 MP to 120 MP.
blocks.zh:
CrossRPO需要的集,其版本仅在证据上有所不同,并且有不同的正确答案.
本节介绍这类数据集的三套数据集:VIRA-Bench,VIRA-Bench-Real和VIRA-Train,它们由21 MP至120 MP的超高分辨率照片构建.

blocks.en:
Building a contrast set. The original photos are color photos from Wikimedia Commons.
We use a vision-language model to find an object in a photo that can be changed into K − 1 K-1 other versions.
For K = 3 K=3 , a smartphone in a hand (the original s 1 s_{1} ) can be changed into a calculator (variant s 2 s_{2} ) and a TV remote (variant s 3 s_{3} ), as in Figure a.
An image editor redraws the object for each variant, and only the region of the old and new object is pasted back into the photo.
A language model writes a question q q about the object with four options, including the correct answer y v y_{v} of every version and at least one distractor.
The question first states the location of the object and never names the changed attribute.
Some variants contradict common sense, so a model that guesses gives the original’s answer (Figure 1 ).
The same versions can serve several sets: another question q ′ q^{\prime} with answers y v ′ y^{\prime}_{v} gives the set ( q ′ , ( s v , y v ′ ) v = 1 K ) (q^{\prime},(s_{v},y^{\prime}_{v})_{v=1}^{K}) .
After automatic checks, human reviewers check every ViRA-Bench question (Appendix B.1 ).
blocks.zh:
建立对照组。 原照片是来自维基媒体常识的彩色照片.
我们使用视觉语言模型在照片中找到一个可以更改为K−1 K-1其他版本的物体.
对于K = 3 K = 3,手式智能手机(原型为s1 s_{1})可以改为计算器(变型为s2 s_{2})和电视遥控器(变型为s3 s_{3}),如图a.
一个图像编辑器为每个变体重新绘制对象,只有新旧对象的区域被粘贴回照片中.
一个语言模型写出一个有关对象的q q 问题,有四个选项,包括每个版本的正确答案y v y_{v}和至少一个分心器.
问题首先说明对象的位置,而从未给更改的属性命名.
一些变体与常识相矛盾,因此一个猜测给出原生答案的模型(图1).
同样的版本可以服务于几套:另一个问题 q ' q ' prime } 用答案 y v ' y ' prime {v} 给集 (q ', (s v, y v ) v = 1 K) (q ' prime }, (s_{v},y^{\prime}_{v}) _{v= 1}^{K}) 。 。 。
在自动检查后,人类审查员检查每个VIRA-Bench问题(附录B.1 ).

blocks.en:
ViRA-Bench contains 762 contrast sets on 466 photos of 24 to 108 MP (Figure 1 ).
Each set has K = 3 K=3 versions, the original O and the two variants A and B.
An object is kept only if its longer side is at most 13 pixels when the photo is reduced to 1 MP and its shorter side is at least 28 pixels at full resolution, so a model must zoom in to read it.
The edited object covers a median of 0.0075% of the photo (Figure 3 b).
Of the questions, 458 ask for a visible property, 209 add a step of reasoning, and 95 involve several objects.
The metric is set accuracy, the share of sets with all three versions answered correctly.
The first zoom of every agent covers the object equally often on the edited variants and on the original (Appendix B.2 ): the two shares differ by at most 2.4 percentage points at every budget .
blocks.zh:
VIRA-Bench包含762套对比度,466张24至108 MP的照片(图1 ).
每个集有K = 3 K = 3个版本,原始O和两个变体A和B.
只有在将照片缩小为1 MP时其较长的侧面最多为13像素,且其较短的侧面在全分辨率下至少为28像素时,才保留一个物体,因此模型必须缩放以读取.
编辑对象覆盖照片中位数0.0075%(图3b).
其中,458人要求有明显的属性,209人增加了一个推理步骤,95人涉及多个物体.
衡量标准是设定准确度,所有三个版本的套数比例答对了。
每种剂的第一个缩放在编辑过的变体上和原始(附录B.2)上都同样地覆盖对象:在每一个预算上,两种股份最多2.4个百分点。

blocks.en:
ViRA-Bench-Real. To exclude editing traces, ViRA-Bench-Real contains 78 sets that were photographed without any editing (Figure 1 , right; Appendix B.3 ).
Its 234 photos were taken with a Nikon Z8 camera.
Between the three shots of a set, only the object was swapped.
The swapped objects are posters, signs, stickers, labels and small everyday objects.
The photos have 45.4 MP, and the objects cover a median of 0.0017% of the photo.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2018-03-27). ViRA - Bench - Real. 为了排除编辑痕迹,VIRA-Bench-Real载有78套未经任何编辑而拍摄的照片(图1,右;附录B.3)。
它的234张照片是用Nikon Z8相机拍摄的.
在一组的三拍之间,只有对象被互换.
互换对象有海报,标志,贴纸,标签和小型日常物品.
照片有45.4 MP,物体覆盖了照片的中位数0.0017%.

blocks.en:
ViRA-Train contains 6,457 contrast sets on 3,797 Commons photos of 21 to 120 MP that are not in ViRA-Bench (Appendix B.4 ).
Of these sets, 4,110 have three versions and 2,347 have two.
The edited region has a shorter side of at least 20 pixels at full resolution, and its longer side has a median of 16 pixels at 1 MP.
ViRA-Train also contains 2,804 single images as sets with K = 1 K=1 .
They are questions about details in Commons photos, questions about several objects in photos and maps, math problems from ThinkLite-VL [ 68 ] and synthetic charts.
blocks.zh:
VIRA-Train包含有6,457个对比集,包含在3,797个普通人照片上,21到120个不位于VIRA-Bench的MP(附录B.4 .
其中,4,110套有三个版本,2,347套有两个版本。
编辑区域在全分辨率下有至少20像素的更短的一面,其更长的一面在1 MP时有16像素的中位数.
VIRA-Train还包含有2,804个单一的图像作为设定,其中K=1K=1.
它们是关于Commons照片中细节的问题,关于照片和地图中几个物体的问题,来自ThinkLite-VL的数学问题[68]和合成图.

blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
Training. We train Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with CrossRPO ( λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 ) and obtain ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B.
For each base model, we first remove the contrast sets that it solves without zooming at 12.8 MP and the single images that it answers correctly in at least seven or in none of eight attempts, because the advantages in Eq. ( 5 ) are zero when the rollouts of a version are all correct or all wrong.
ViRA-9B then trains on 3,642 items and ViRA-27B on 3,401 (Table 13 ), fewer than any trained baseline reports (Table 15 ).
For ViRA-9B, these are 1,664 contrast sets and 1,978 single images, and for ViRA-27B, 1,338 contrast sets and 2,063 single images.
A contrast set counts as one item: we sample n = 12 / K n=12/K rollouts per version, so a set receives 12 rollouts in total, the same as one input of GRPO.
Each photo is viewed at a budget drawn log-uniformly between 0.5 and 16.8 MP with up to six zooms (Appendix C ).
The reward is the correctness of the final answer, and GPT-4o judges open answers against the reference answer.
Each model makes one pass over its items with 16 items per step, which is 227 steps for ViRA-9B and 212 steps for ViRA-27B, and training takes 12.7 and 29.6 hours on eight H200 GPUs (Appendix C.4 ).
blocks.zh:
培训。 我们用CrossRPO(QQ=0.5\lambda=0.5)进行Quen3.5-9B和Quen3.8-27B的列车,并获得VIRA-9B和VIRA-27B.
对于每一个基模型,我们首先去掉它所解的对比集,而不缩放到12.8 MP,以及它在至少7个尝试中正确回答或者在8个尝试中没有正确回答的单个图像,因为当一个版本的推出全部正确或者全部错误时,Eq. (5)中的优点是零.
然后,VIRA-9B对3 642件物品进行列车,VIRA-27B对3 401件物品进行列车(表13),比任何经过培训的基准报告(表15)少。
对于VIRA-9B,这些是1,664套对比度和1,978个单图像,对于VIRA-27B,1,338套对比度和2,063个单图像.
一个对比设定计数为一个项目:我们每个版本的样本n = 12 / K n = 12/K,所以一个集共收到12个滚动,与GRPO的一个输入相同.
每张照片在0.5至16.8 MP之间统一绘制的预算显示,最多可显示6个缩放(附录C)。
奖励是最终答案的正确性,GPT-4o评委根据参考答案打开答案.
每个型号每步一次通过项目16项,VIRA-9B为227步,VIRA-27B为212步,8个H200GPU(附录C.4)的训练需要12.7和29.6小时.

blocks.en:
Benchmarks. We evaluate on ten benchmarks (Appendix D.2 ).
ViRA-Bench and ViRA-Bench-Real measure set accuracy at 0.5, 1, 2 and 4 MP and at each model’s maximum.
ViRA-Bench has 762 sets, and ViRA-Bench-Real has 78.
A model’s maximum is the largest input that it accepts, which is 16.8 MP for the open models of the Qwen3 family, 12.8 MP for those based on Qwen2.5-VL, 3.8 MP for Claude Haiku 5.5 and 30.7 MP for GPT-6-Luna.
The other eight are general benchmarks , which measure accuracy on single-image questions at 1 MP and the maximum: V ∗ [ 73 ] , HR-Bench 4K and 8K [ 66 ] , MME-RealWorld-Lite [ 84 ] , TreeBench [ 65 ] , O3-Bench [ 36 ] , MMStar [ 8 ] and HallusionBench [ 19 ] .
Most images of MMStar and HallusionBench are below 1 MP, so we report these two benchmarks only at the maximum.
The budget caps the pixels of the first view and of every crop.
We also report the tokens per set, which are the prompt tokens of all turns plus the generated tokens, summed over the versions of the set.
blocks.zh:
基准。 我们对10项基准(附录D.2)进行评价。
VIRA-Bench和VIRA-Bench-Real测量定精度为0.5、1、2和4MP,每个模型的最高精度。
VIRA-Bench有762套,VIRA-Bench-Real有78套.
一个模型的最大输入量是它所接受的最大输入量,即Qune3家族开放模型的16.8 MP,基于Qune2.5-VL的12.8 MP,Claude Haiku 5.5的3.8 MP和GPT-6-Luna的30.7 MP.
其余8个是一般基准,它们以1 MP和最高值衡量单一图像问题的准确性:V * [73]、HR-Bench 4K和8K [66]、MME-Real World-Lite [84]、Treathe Bench [65]、O3-Bench [36]、MMStar [8]和Halusion Bench [19]。
MMStar和Halliusion Bench的大多数图像低于1 MP,因此我们只能以最大速度报告这两个基准.
预算封顶了第一视图和每个作物的像素.
我们还报告每集的代号,这些代号是所有转弯的即时代号,加上生成的代号,这些代号在集的版本上汇总.

blocks.en:
Baselines. The open baselines Qwen3.5-9B, ZwZ2-9B [ 71 ] , Vision-OPD-9B [ 81 ] , Qwen3.8-27B and ZwZ2-27B run without a tool and with a zoom tool ( + tool ).
ZwZ2 and Vision-OPD are trained to read fine details without a tool, and with the zoom tool every open baseline may zoom up to six times.
The released agents use their own tools: Mini-o3 [ 33 ] , DeepEyes [ 87 ] , DeepEyesV2 [ 25 ] , Thyme [ 85 ] , Pixel Reasoner [ 59 ] and ZoomEye [ 57 ] (7–9B), and LBS-27B [ 78 ] and SenseNova-MARS-32B [ 9 ] (27–32B).
The 7–9B agents are based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and keep the tools, prompts and turn limits they were trained with, and ZoomEye searches a tree of crops without training.
Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna call our zoom tool through the function calling of their APIs, at max, medium and no thinking.
Decoding is greedy, and ViRA and the ablations are averaged over three runs on ViRA-Bench, ViRA-Bench-Real (Appendices D.1 and E ).
blocks.zh:
基线。 开放式基线 Qune3.5-9B,ZwZ2-9B [71],Vision-OPD-9B [81],Qune3.8-27B和ZwZ227B 运行时没有工具,并带有缩放工具(+工具).
ZwZ2和Visual-OPD经过培训,可以在没有工具的情况下读取精细细节,而使用缩放工具,每个开放基线可放大6倍。
释放的特工使用自己的工具:Mini-o3 [33],DeepEyes [87],DeepEyes V2 [25],Thyme [85],Pixel Reasoner [59]和ZomEye [57] (7–9B),以及LBS-27B [78]和SenseNova-MARS-32B [9] (27–32B).
7-9B的特工以Quen2.5-VL-7B为基础,并保留工具、提示和转弯限制,ZoomEye在没有训练的情况下搜索一棵作物树。
Claude Haiku 5.5和GPT-6-Luna通过他们的API的函数调用我们的缩放工具,在最大,中和无思维.
解码很贪婪,VIRA和bloods平均在VIRA-Bench,VIRA-Bench-Real(Appendices D.1和E.)的3个以上运行.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 gives the set accuracy and the tokens per set of every model on ViRA-Bench and ViRA-Bench-Real, and Table 2 gives the accuracy of every model on the general benchmarks.
Both tables group the models into the 7–9B models, the 27–32B models and the proprietary models, and a Δ \Delta row gives the gain of ViRA over its base model with the zoom tool.
ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B are the most accurate open models of their sizes on ten and nine of the ten benchmarks .

VIRA-9B和VIRA-27B是十项基准中十项基准和九项基准中最精确的开放模型。

blocks.en:
ViRA-Bench. Without a zoom tool, no open model solves more than 15.1% of the sets below its maximum resolution (Table 1 ).
The gain of ViRA-9B over its base model with the zoom tool grows with the budget, from 17.6 to 28.7 points.
The released 7–9B agents stay below the untrained Qwen3.5-9B with the zoom tool at every budget: they reach a per-image accuracy of 30 to 51% (Table 16 ) but solve at most 21.1% of the sets.
ViRA-9B is also ahead of the open 27B models with the zoom tool, and ViRA-27B, after RL on only 3,401 items, is ahead of every proprietary model at every budget.
Claude Haiku 5.5 at max thinking uses about 2 to 6 times as many tokens as ViRA-9B (Figure b) and is ahead of it below the maximum resolution.
Both proprietary models are less accurate at every budget with medium thinking and again without thinking, and GPT-6-Luna at max thinking falls from 55.6% at 4 MP to 26.6% at its maximum resolution.
Figure 4 shows where nine agents look on one contrast set.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2017-09-27). ViRA - Bench. 没有缩放工具,没有开放模型可以解决超过15.1%的集低于其最大分辨率(表1).
VIRA-9B在使用缩放工具的基础模型上的增益随着预算的增长而增加,从17.6点增加到28.7点.
释放的7–9B剂在未经过训练的Quen3.5-9B下方保留着每个预算的缩放工具:它们达到30-51%的每个图像精度(表16),但最多能解决21.1%的集.
VIRA-9B也领先于使用缩放工具的开放的27B型机车,在仅3,401项的RL之后,VIRA-27B领先于每个预算的每个专有型机车.
Claude Haiku 5.5 at max disception使用比VIRA-9B(图b)多约2至6倍的代币,并在最大分辨率以下领先.
两种专有模式在每一个预算都不太准确,有中度思维,再无思维,最大思维的GPT-6-Luna从55.6%(4 MP)下降到26.6%(最高分辨率).
图4显示9名特工在一个对照组上的位置。

blocks.en:
ViRA-Bench-Real. ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B also lead the open models of their sizes on photographed sets (Table 1 ), so their lead does not depend on edited images.
Without a zoom tool, no open model solves more than 5.1% of the sets below its maximum resolution.
The released 7–9B agents reach a per-image accuracy of 30 to 60% (Table 16 ) but solve at most 28.2% of the sets.
ViRA-27B is within 0.5 points of Claude Haiku 5.5 at 0.5 MP and ahead of it from 1 MP on.
blocks.zh:
VIRA-Bench-Real. VIRA-9B和VIRA-27B同样在照片集(表1)上领跑其大小的开放模型,因此其领先并不依赖于经过编辑的图像.
没有缩放工具,没有开放的模型可以解决其最大分辨率以下超过5.1%的集.
释放的7~9B剂达到30~60%的成像精度(表16),但最多能解决28.2%的成像.
ViRA-27B在克洛德·海库5.5的0.5点以0.5的MP以内,领先于1的MP on.

blocks.en:
General benchmarks. ViRA-9B gains 5.6 to 21.8 points over its base model with the zoom tool, and ViRA-27B gains 3.5 to 24.4 points (Table 2 ).
Among the open models of their sizes, ViRA-9B is the most accurate on all eight benchmarks and ViRA-27B on seven.
ZoomEye searches a tree of crops with Qwen2.5-VL-7B and is not trained.
On V ∗ and HR-Bench, its accuracy is within the range of the five trained agents, but it is 9.8 to 19.9 points below ViRA-9B.
ViRA-27B is ahead of both proprietary models on five of the eight benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
一般基准。 VIRA-9B用缩放工具比其基准模型获得5.6至21.8分,VIRA-27B获得3.5至24.4分(表2)。
在其大小的开放模型中,VIRA-9B在所有8个基准中最为准确,VIRA-27B在7个基准中最为准确.
ZoomEye用Quen2.5-VL-7B搜索一棵作物树,没有经过训练.
在V * 和HR-Bench上,它的精确度在5名训练有素的特工的范围之内,但比VIRA-9B低9.8至19.9点.
VIRA-27B在八项基准中的五项领先于两种专有模式.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.3 违约

blocks.en: All ablations (Table 3 ) start from Qwen3.5-9B with the same data, reward, protocol and number of steps as ViRA-9B, and only the advantage changes (Appendix G.1 ).
blocks.zh: 所有缩写(表3)从Quen3.5-9B开始,与VIRA-9B相同数据,奖励,协议和步骤数,只有优势变化(附录G.1 ).

blocks.en:
Joint term. Without the joint term ( λ = 0 \lambda=0 ), each version is trained separately with RLOO, and set accuracy on ViRA-Bench drops at every budget, by 4.6 to 7.4 points.
On the general benchmarks, accuracy changes by at most 2 points, except on O3-Bench, where it drops by 6.9 points at 1 MP.
Without the joint term, the last zoom covers the object as often, but accuracy at 1 MP is 2.4 points lower on the originals and 5.2 and 5.3 points lower on the variants (Appendix H ), so the joint term improves reading, not finding.
blocks.zh:
联合学期. 没有联合名词(QQ=0\lambda=0),每个版本都与RLOO单独训练,并将VIRA-Bench的精度设定在每个预算上,以4.6到7.4分.
在一般基准上,精度在除O3-奔驰外,在最多2点时会变化,在1 MP时会下降6.9点.
没有联合名词,上一个缩放也经常覆盖对象,但1 MP的精度在原版上低2.4分,在变体上低5.2分和5.3分(Appendix H ),因此联合名词改进了读数,而不是发现.

blocks.en:
Random partners. The versions in a batch are assigned to the sets at random, so the weight w v w_{v} of an image is computed from images of other questions.
Set accuracy then stays close to that of λ = 0 \lambda=0 , as Proposition A.38 predicts.
blocks.zh:
随机伴侣. 批次中的版本被随机分配到集中,所以一个图像的重量w v w_{v}是从其他问题的图像中计算出来的.
如提案A.38所预测的那样,设定精度后保持接近QQ=0\lambda=0.

blocks.en:
Value of λ \lambda . With λ = 2 \lambda=2 , set accuracy is higher at low budgets but lower at the maximum resolution and on every general benchmark, and λ = 1 \lambda=1 is lower on ViRA-Bench at every budget.
From 2 MP on, λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 is the most accurate variant on ViRA-Bench .
With λ = 2 \lambda=2 , the agent also zooms 2.7 times per image and uses 34K to 346K tokens per set, against 12K to 147K (Table 17 ).
blocks.zh:
\\ lambda 的值 。 在QQ = 2\lambda = 2的情况下,设定的精确度在低预算时较高,但在最高分辨率和每个一般基准上较低,而QQ = 1\lambda = 1 在VIRA-Bench上,在每个预算时,设定的精确度较低.
从2 MP on,QQ=0.5\lambda=0.5是VIRA-Bench上最准确的变体.
使用QQ=2\lambda=2,该剂还放大了每个图像的2.7倍,每集使用34K至346K令牌,而12K至147K(表17).

blocks.en:
One group per version. Per-version GRPO is λ = 0 \lambda=0 with the advantages of each version divided by their standard deviation.
It is behind CrossRPO from 2 MP on ViRA-Bench and on every general benchmark, but ahead at 0.5 and 1 MP on ViRA-Bench and up to 4 MP on ViRA-Bench-Real.
Its agent zooms two to three times per image where CrossRPO zooms once, and uses about twice as many tokens (Appendix G.2 ).
blocks.zh:
每个版本一个组. Per-version GRPO为QQ=0\lambda=0,每个版本的优点除以其标准偏差.
它落后于CrossRPO,来自维拉-奔驰的2名议员和每个一般基准,但领先于维拉-奔驰的0.5和1名议员和维拉-奔驰-雷亚尔的4名议员.
它的代理放大了CrossRPO一次放大的每个图像2到3次,并且使用了大约两倍的代号(Appendix G.2 ).

blocks.en:
One group per set. Pooled RLOO is λ = 0 \lambda=0 with the leave-one-out mean taken over all rollouts of the set.
On ViRA-Bench, pooled GRPO and pooled RLOO are behind CrossRPO at every budget.
On ViRA-Bench-Real, both are ahead up to 2 MP, and pooled RLOO is ahead because it draws smaller zoom boxes (Appendix G.2 ).
ConsistRoll [ 91 ] , pooled GRPO with a pair bonus, is behind on both benchmarks at every budget.
blocks.zh:
每集一组. Pooled RLOO是QQ=0\lambda=0,其中一停即止的意指接管了集的所有推出.
在VIRA-Bench,集合的GRPO和集合的RLOO在每个预算中都落后于CrossRPO.
在VIRA-Bench-Real上,两者都领先于2名MP,集合的RLOO则领先于前,因为它绘制了较小的缩放箱(Appendix G.2 .
Consist Roll [91], 集合的GRPO带双倍奖金,在每个预算上都落后于两个基准.

blocks.en: 5.4 Generalizability and Scalability
blocks.zh: 5.4 通用性和可扩展性

blocks.en:
Generalization to text. The joint term does not depend on images.
It needs only sets of inputs that share one question and have different answers.
Questions about passages that contradict known facts give such sets in text.
There, the model’s memory plays the role of common sense, and the passage plays the role of the evidence.
We therefore train Qwen3.5-9B on text contrast sets, without images and without the zoom tool.
blocks.zh:
通论为文字. 联合名词不依赖于图像.
它只需要一组共同的问题和不同的答案。
关于与已知事实相矛盾的段落的问题在案文中给出了这些段落。
在那里,模型的记忆起到常识的作用,通道则起到证据的作用.
因此,我们在文本对比集上训练Quen3.5-9B,没有图像,也没有缩放工具.

blocks.en:
Data. ConFiQA [ 4 ] asks questions about facts from Wikidata, and its passages were written by an LLM from these facts.
We use its three subsets, which have single-hop questions (QA), multi-hop questions (MR) and multi-hop questions with several replaced facts (MC).
Each ConFiQA item has the original passage and a copy in which the answer entity is replaced.
A set with K = 3 K=3 has the original passage (O), this copy (A) and one more copy (B), in which we replace the answer of A with another entity of the same Wikidata relation.
No substituted passage mentions the original answer, so an answer from the model’s memory is correct only on O.
We hold out 1,660 questions of the three subsets for testing.
Of the other questions, we train only on the 2,856 that the base model answers correctly without the passage, so its memory gives the original answer on every version.
The 493 test questions with this property form the strong-prior subset in Table 4 .
blocks.zh:
Data. ConFiQA [4] 从维基数据中询问事实,其段落由来自这些事实的LLM撰写.
我们使用它的三个子集,这些子集有单跳问题(QA),多跳问题(MR)和多跳问题,有多个替换的事实(MC).
每个ConFiQA项目都有原始段落和一份副本,用于替换答案实体.
K = 3 K = 3 的集有原始段落(O),此副本(A)和另外一份副本(B),其中我们将A的回答替换为与Wikidata关系相同的另一个实体.
没有替代段落提到原始答案,所以模型记忆中的答案只在O上正确.
我们提出三个子集的1 660个问题进行测试。
在其他的问题中,我们只训练基础模型没有通过正确回答的2,856,所以它的内存给出了每个版本的原始答案.
带有这种属性的493个测试问题构成表4中的强优先子集。

blocks.en:
Training. The model reads the passage and the question, reasons, and then answers with a word or phrase in a single turn.
The reward is accuracy.
An answer is correct if it contains the answer of its version or an alias, and it is wrong if it also names the answer of another version.
Each step samples 16 sets, and each version has four rollouts, so a set receives 12 rollouts as in the image runs.
CrossRPO uses λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 , and λ = 0 \lambda=0 , pooled GRPO and pooled RLOO are defined as in Appendix G.1 .
All runs use the same data and 178 steps, which is about one pass over the training questions.
We train each method three times with different random seeds.
blocks.zh:
培训。 模型读出段落和问题,理由,然后用单转的单词或短语回答.
奖励是准确的。
如果答案包含其版本的答案或别名,那么答案是正确的,如果同时将另一个版本的答案命名为错误.
每个步骤样本16集,每个版本有四个展开,所以一个集合像图像运行一样接收12个展开.
CrossRPO使用 QQ = 0.5\lambda = 0.5,和 QQ = 0\lambda = 0,集合GRPO和集合RLOO的定义在附录G.1中.
所有运行都使用同样的数据和178步,这大约是一个通过训练问题.
我们用不同的随机种子训练了三次每种方法。

blocks.en:
Test sets. The ConFiQA test questions come from the same source as the training questions.
NQ-Swap [ 46 ] and FaithEval [ 48 ] come from other sources, and we did not train on them.
NQ-Swap takes questions and Wikipedia passages from Natural Questions and replaces the answer entity in the passage.
We test 1,000 random NQ-Swap questions, each with the substituted and the original passage.
FaithEval (counterfactual task) has 1,000 multiple-choice science questions from ARC-Challenge.
For each question, an LLM wrote a passage that supports a counterfactual answer, and this answer is the correct option.
The model answers with the letter of an option.
ConFiQA and NQ-Swap answers are scored with the rule of the reward.
blocks.zh:
测试集。 ConFiQA测试问题与训练问题来自同一来源.
NQ-Swap[46]和FaithEval[48]来自其他来源,我们没有对他们进行培训。
NQ-Swap从Natural Questions中接受提问和维基百科的段落,并取代了段落中的答案实体.
我们测试1000个随机的NQ-Swap问题,每个问题都有替换和原始段落.
FaithEval(反事实任务)有1000个来自ARC-Challenge的多选择科学问题.
对于每个问题,一个LLM写了一个支持反事实答案的段落,这个答案是正确的选项.
模型用选项的字母回答.
ConFiQA和NQ-Swap的答案以奖励规则得分.

blocks.en:
Results. Table 4 gives, for ConFiQA, the share of test sets with all three versions answered correctly, the accuracy on each version, and the rate at which an answer on A or B is the original fact.
For NQ-Swap, it gives the accuracy on substituted and on original passages and the rate of answers with the original fact, and for FaithEval the accuracy.
Averaged over the three training runs, CrossRPO answers all three versions of 81.9% of the test sets, against 81.0% for λ = 0 \lambda=0 , 79.6% for pooled GRPO, 80.2% for pooled RLOO and 58.6% for the base model.
It also gives the original fact on a substituted passage least often.
On the strong-prior questions, it is on par with pooled GRPO.
On NQ-Swap with substituted passages and on FaithEval, all four methods are within 2.0 points.
blocks.zh:
结果。 对于ConFiQA,表4给出了所有三个版本的测试集中答案正确的比例,每个版本的准确性,以及A或B上的答案是原始事实的速度.
对NQ-Swap来说,它给出了替换段落和原始段落上的准确度和与原始事实的答案率,对FaithEval来说,它给出了准确度.
平均而言,CrossRPO在三次培训中都回答所有三个版本的81.9%的测试组合,而XQ=0\lambda=0的测试组合为81.0%,GRPO为79.6%,RLOO为80.2%,基模为58.6%。
它还使替代段落的原始事实最少。
在强优先问题上,它与集合的GPRO是平等的。
在使用替换通道的NQ-Swap和FaithEval上,所有四种方法都在2.0点之内.

blocks.en:
Table 4 : Text contrast sets (ConFiQA, K = 3 K=3 , Qwen3.5-9B): accuracy (%) and the rate of answering with the original fact (lower is better). NQ-Swap and FaithEval were not trained on. Strong-prior questions: the base model answers them correctly without the passage.
Each method is trained three times with different random seeds, and each run and the base model are evaluated three times.
Cells give the mean and the standard deviation over the three training runs. Bold: best in each row.
blocks.zh:
表4:文本对比集(ConFiQA,K = 3 K = 3,Quen3.5-9B):精度(%)和与原始事实的答录率(下比更好). NQ-Swap和FaithEval没有受过培训。 强前题:基模没有通过正确回答.
每种方法用不同的随机种子训练了3次,每种跑步和基模评价3次.
单元格给出了三次训练的平均值和标准偏差。 粗体:每行最好.

blocks.en:
Scaling to larger sets. Image contrast sets with more than three versions are hard to build, because each further version needs another edit of the same small object that gives a different answer and passes review.
Text sets have no such limit, so we test how CrossRPO scales with K K on ConFiQA.
For K > 3 K>3 , each set adds versions in which the answer entity is replaced by other entities of the same Wikidata relation, as in B.
The training sets have 2,645 strong-prior questions for K = 4 K=4 and 8 and 2,627 for K = 16 K=16 .
Every version has four rollouts, and at each K K the four methods use the same data and number of steps, about one pass over the training questions.
The weight of a version in the joint term is then computed from pairs of the other versions (Eq. ( 15 )).
We test on 1,660 questions, and on 1,653 for K = 16 K=16 .
Again, each method is trained three times.
Table 5 gives the share of test sets with all versions answered correctly and the accuracy per version, and it repeats K = 3 K=3 for comparison.
At K = 4 K=4 , 8 and 16, CrossRPO answers the most sets correctly on average.
It is 1.0 to 8.0 points ahead of λ = 0 \lambda=0 , 0.8 to 2.4 points ahead of pooled GRPO and 0.2 to 4.6 points ahead of pooled RLOO.
Its accuracy per version is also the highest for every K K , at 91.5%, 93.4% and 94.6%, which is 0.8 to 1.6 points above pooled GRPO and 0.1 to 2.1 points above pooled RLOO.
These text experiments are small, and we leave larger ones to future work.
blocks.zh:
放大到更大的镜头。 超过三个版本的图像对比集很难构建,因为每个进一步的版本都需要对同一个小对象进行另一次编辑,给出不同的答案并经过审查.
文本集没有这样的限制,所以我们在ConFiQA上测试了CrossRPO如何与K K比对.
用于 K > 3K>3,每集增加版本,其中答案实体由同Wikidata关系的其他实体所取代,如B.
成套训练有2,645个强前题,分别为K=4个K=4,8个和K=16个K=16个2,627个.
每个版本都有四个推出版本,每K K四个方法使用相同的数据和步骤数,大约一个通过训练问题.
一个版本在联合名词中的权重随后从其他版本的对数(Eq. (15 ))计算.
我们测试1,660个问题,1,653个K=16个K=16个。
同样,每种方法都经过三次训练。
表5给出了所有版本正确回答的测试集的比例和每个版本的准确性,它重复K=3K=3进行比较.
在K = 4 K = 4,8和16时,CrossRPO平均回答最正确的组合.
它比QQ=0\lambda=0领先1.0至8.0分,比集合GRPO领先0.8至2.4分,比集合RLOO领先0.2至4.6分.
每KK版本的准确度也最高,为91.5%、93.4%和94.6%,高于集合GRPO0.8至1.6分,高于集合RLOO0.1至2.1分。
这些文字实验是小的,我们把更大的实验留给将来的工作.

blocks.en:
Table 5 : Text sets with K K versions (ConFiQA, Qwen3.5-9B): accuracy (%) on the test questions at the K K used in training.
For K > 3 K>3 , the joint term of CrossRPO uses pairs of other versions (Eq. ( 15 )).
Each method is trained three times with different random seeds, and each run is evaluated three times.
Cells give the mean and the standard deviation over the three training runs. Bold: best in each row and group.
blocks.zh:
表5: KK版本的文本集(ConFiQA, Quen3.5-9B):在培训中使用的 KK测试题上的准确性(%).
用于 K > 3 K>3,CrossRPO的联合术语使用其他版本的对(Eq. (15)).
每种方法经过三次训练,都有不同的随机种子,每次跑步都要经过三次评价.
单元格给出了三次训练的平均值和标准偏差。 粗体:每排和每组最好.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Visual agents often answer from common sense.
In this paper, we propose CrossRPO, which trains visual agents on contrast sets, rewards solving the whole set, and provably does not reinforce a set answered from common sense.
We build ViRA-Train and ViRA-Bench by editing one small object in photos of 21 to 120 MP, and photograph ViRA-Bench-Real.
CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO.
After RL on about 3,500 items each, ViRA-9B leads open models of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna at their highest thinking level on most benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
视觉代理人经常从常识中回答.
在本文中,我们提出CrossRPO,它训练视觉代理在对比设定上,奖励解决整个设定,并且可以证明不会强化从常识中解答的设定.
我们通过编辑21到120 MP照片中的一个小对象, 以及VIRA-Bench-Real的照片,来构建VIRA-Train和VIRA-Bench。
CrossRPO在VIRA-Bench上达到63.3%的精度设定在最高分辨率,而GRPO的精度为59.3%.
在每条约3500项的RL之后,VIRA-9B在所有基准上领先其大小的开放模型,而VIRA-27B在大多数基准上的最高思维水平都超过了克劳德·海库·5.5和GPT-6-Luna.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Data. ViRA-Bench and ViRA-Train are made by image editing, so traces inside an edited object could affect the answer.
The first zoom covers the object equally often on the edited and the unedited versions (Appendix B.2 ), so the edits do not guide the search, but the test does not cover reading.
ViRA-Bench-Real has no edits, but it has only 78 sets, which were shot indoors with one camera and show mostly posters, signs, stickers and labels.
A photographed benchmark at the scale of ViRA-Bench, with outdoor scenes and more kinds of objects, would be a stronger test.
Each question also describes where the object is, which makes the search easier than a question without this description would.
The image sets have at most three versions, so larger sets are tested only on text.
blocks.zh:
数据. ViRA-Bench和VIRA-Train是通过图像编辑制作的,因此编辑对象内部的痕迹可能影响答案.
第一个缩放在编辑版和未经编辑的版本(Appendix B.2 )上同样地覆盖对象,因此编辑不指导搜索,但测试不覆盖阅读.
ViRA-Bench-Real没有编辑,但只有78套,室内用一台照相机拍摄,并主要展示海报,标志,贴纸和标签.
以VIRA-Bench为尺度的摄影基准,加上户外场景和更多种类的物体,将是一个更强大的测试.
每个问题还描述了对象的位置,这使得搜索比没有这种描述的问题更容易.
图像集最多有三个版本,因此较大的集只在文本上测试.

blocks.en:
Method. CrossRPO requires sets whose versions differ only in the evidence and have different answers (Proposition A.40 ).
Such sets need an image editor or a second photo of the scene, so they cost more to build than single images.
Its gain over λ = 0 \lambda=0 is mainly on contrast sets.
A single image has no other version, so its cross-input weight is zero, and CrossRPO then trains it as RLOO does.

方法。 方法吗? CrossRPO需要的集,其版本仅在证据上有所不同,并且有不同的答案(Proposition A.40.
这种设定需要图像编辑器或场景的第二张照片,因此它们比单一图像的构建成本更高.
它的增益超过QQ=0\lambda=0主要在对比集上.
单一的图像没有其他版本,因此其交叉输入重量为零,CrossRPO然后像RLOO那样对其进行训练.

blocks.en:
Agents. The reward is accuracy only, so nothing encourages tight boxes or further zooms.
ViRA-9B usually zooms once with a large box (Appendix G.2 ).
At low budgets, a very small object then stays small in the crop, and a reward on the object’s size in the last view could lead to tighter boxes.

探员 奖励只是准确的,所以没有任何东西鼓励紧凑的盒子或进一步放大.
VIRA-9B通常一次用一个大盒子放大一次(附录G.2.
在低预算时,一个很小的物体在作物中保持小块,在最后的视图中奖励物体的大小可以导致收紧的盒子.

blocks.en:
Evaluation. Only one family of base models is trained.
ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B start from Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B, and we have not tested CrossRPO on other architectures.
The baselines run with their own tools and prompts, and the proprietary models use our tool through their APIs.
The ablations of Table 3 share the data, the reward and the tool, so they isolate the effect of the advantage.

评价。 只有一个基地模型家族接受了培训。
VIRA-9B和VIRA-27B从Quen3.5-9B和Quen3.8-27B开始,我们还没有在其他建筑上测试过CrossRPO.
基线用他们自己的工具和提示运行,专有模型通过他们的API使用我们的工具.
表3的缩写分享了数据,奖励和工具,因此它们隔离了优势的效果.

blocks.en:
Text. The text experiments are small.
They train one base model for one pass over fewer than 3,000 questions of one dataset.
They show that the joint term transfers to text, not the accuracy that it can reach there.
We leave text experiments at a larger scale to future work.

他们训练一个基础模型,通过一个数据集不到3000个问题。
它们表明,联合术语向文本转移,而不是它能够达到的准确性。
我们把文字实验放在更大的范围 留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Appendix A Theory of CrossRPO
blocks.zh: 附录A 交叉理论

blocks.en:
This section derives CrossRPO from first principles and proves every statement.
The argument has four steps.
(i) We formalize policies, sets of inputs and rollout sampling (Appendix A.1 ) and prove the score-function identities behind group-based policy gradients (Appendix A.2 ).
(ii) We show that accuracy on each version cannot distinguish an answer that is read from the evidence from an answer that is taken from the prior, whereas the accuracy on a whole set can.
We define the objective accordingly (Appendix A.3 ).
(iii) For an arbitrary set-level reward, we construct a family of unbiased gradient estimators.
The CrossRPO advantage is its closed form for our objective (Appendix A.4 ).
(iv) The estimator involves three design choices, and prior work makes different ones.
We compare them under four requirements: unbiasedness (Appendix A.5 ), variance (Appendix A.6 ), credit assignment (Appendix A.7 ) and scale (Appendix A.8 ).
Appendix A.9 extends the construction to all correctness-based set rewards, shows that for K ≥ 3 K\geq 3 the joint term is not a sum of pairwise terms, and recovers RLOO and GRPO as special cases.
Appendix A.10 shows which inputs should form a set.
The joint term helps only if the members share a shortcut and have different answers, and for members grouped at random it reduces in expectation to a constant reweighting of RLOO.
Appendix A.11 locates prior methods in the framework (Table 6 ).
Appendix A.12 checks three of the results on logged rollouts, and Appendix A.13 summarizes the argument (Table 7 ).
Only elementary probability is assumed.

A baseline pooled over all versions does not depend on o v , i o_{v,i} either, so it is unbiased by Corollary A.6 .
Pairing rollouts by index without looking at outcomes is unbiased as well (Theorem A.23 ).
GRPO’s division by a group statistic adds a bias [ 44 ] , but the alternatives to (D1)–(D3) can be made unbiased.
The choices must therefore be compared by their variance and by which rollouts they credit.

By Lemma A.22 , g ^ all b = 𝔼 ⁡ [ g ^ Π b ∣ O ] \hat{g}^{b}_{\mathrm{all}}=\mathbb{E}[\hat{g}^{b}_{\Pi}\mid O] for a uniformly random pairing Π \Pi .
A fixed pairing therefore has the same mean as g ^ all b \hat{g}^{b}_{\mathrm{all}} and adds the covariance 𝔼 ⁡ [ Cov ⁡ ( g ^ Π b ∣ O ) ] \mathbb{E}[\Cov(\hat{g}^{b}_{\Pi}\mid O)] of Eq. ( 22 ). g ^ all b \hat{g}^{b}_{\mathrm{all}} is its Rao–Blackwellization [ 5 ] over the pairing, and R ^ v \hat{R}_{v} is a U-statistic [ 24 ] .
Eq. ( 22 ) states this in matrix form, so the variance does not increase in any direction of the parameter space.
Zhou et al . [ 88 ] show that the GRPO gradient with a leave-one-out baseline and without division by the standard deviation is a second-order U-statistic over pairs of rollouts of one input, and they derive its mean squared error.
The per-version term of CrossRPO is that estimator applied to each version.
The joint term is a U-statistic of another kind, because its kernel takes one rollout from every version and so combines rollouts across inputs.
Theorem A.23 does not cover pairings chosen after observing outcomes, and such pairings change the target.
For example, matching correct rollouts with each other turns the fraction of all-correct combinations into min v ⁡ p ^ v \min_{v}\hat{p}_{v} instead of ∏ v p ^ v \prod_{v}\hat{p}_{v} .
For the set accuracy itself, which is the joint statistic for K ≤ 3 K\leq 3 , the reduction in variance has a closed form.

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
Table 8 summarizes the consequences.
The requirement on a set is therefore not that its members come from one image, but that they share the shortcut to be removed and have pairwise different correct answers.
Contrast sets meet it for the shortcut that matters most for a zoom agent, which is answering from the scene without inspecting the region.
Sets of different photos with the same question meet it for another shortcut, which is answering from the question alone.
Unrelated items meet it for no shortcut.
In expectation, CrossRPO then behaves as RLOO on single items with a slightly larger and noisier accuracy reward, so its benefit over per-item training should appear only on data in which the sets share a shortcut.

Contrast sets在快捷方式上满足它,而快捷方式对于一个缩放的代理来说最为重要,它是在不检查区域的情况下从现场回答.

在预期中,CrossRPO随后在单项上表现为RLOO,其精确度奖励略大,噪声稍高,因此它相对于逐项训练的好处只应出现在各集共享捷径的数据上.

The training data also contain 1,978 single images, so one batch mixes sets with K = 1 K=1 , 2 and 3.

Set accuracy reveals such answers, whereas single-image benchmarks cannot.
The measurements agree (Table 9 ).
On ViRA-Bench, set accuracy with λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 is higher at every budget, by 4.6 to 7.4 points.

Two methods fall outside Eq. ( 15 ).
NoisyRollout samples rollouts on a noisy image but evaluates their log-probabilities on the clean image, so its update is not a score-function estimate on either input.
Its target is K = 1 K=1 , λ = 0 \lambda=0 on the clean image.

Its reward is therefore not a function of one rollout per version in the sense of Definition A.10 , and the anchor receives no policy-gradient term.
Without these contract terms and its pack penalty, BPO optimizes λ = 0 \lambda=0 over the non-anchor views of a pack.

blocks.en: A.12 Offline check
blocks.zh: A.12 联合国 离线检查

blocks.en:
We check three of the results on 1,376 sets (16,090 rollouts) from a run trained with one GRPO group per set.
The version explains 39.5% of the reward variance within a set, and the per-version baseline has 74.9% of the squared residual of the pooled baseline (Proposition A.25 ).
Averaging the index-paired joint term over all pairings removes 63.8% of its squared size (Theorem A.23 ).
Finally, consider rollouts that answer the original correctly while every rollout of the variants is wrong (Proposition A.27 ).
They receive a mean advantage of + 1.69 +1.69 under GRPO and + 0.11 +0.11 under CrossRPO (both scaled to a unit root mean square over the batch).

该版本解释了一套内39.5%的奖励差异,而每版基线占集合基线的平方余量的74.9%(建议A.25)。
在所有配对中使用指数化联合术语,可消除其平方大小的63.8%(定理A.23)。
最后,考虑推出正确回答原文的版本,而每个版本的推出都是错误的(建议A.27)。
它们在GRPO下获得+1.69+1.69的平均优势,在CrossRPO下获得+0.11+0.11的平均优势. (均在批次上缩放为单位根正方形).

The objectives of prior multi-version methods are special cases with K ≤ 2 K\leq 2 , and CRPO coincides with CrossRPO for K = 2 K=2 up to its scale (Propositions A.41 and A.42 ).

blocks.en:
A vision-language model proposes objects whose appearance could plausibly be different, such as a sign, a light, a small device or a part of a vehicle.
SAM 3 [ 6 ] then segments them at full resolution.
Every object has a longer side of at most 13 px at 1 MP and a shorter side of at least 28 px in the photo, so it can be read after zooming but not without zooming.
It is a whole physical object or a printed design such as a pictogram, and not text, a face, a reflection, a shadow or one of a mass of similar things such as leaves.
Other objects of the same kind may appear if the question singles out the target.

一种视觉语言模型提出其外观可能合理不同的物体,如标志,灯光,小装置或车辆的一部分.
SAM 3 [6] 然后以完全的分辨率进行分解.
每个物体在1 MP时最多有13px的侧面,在照片中至少有28px的侧面更短,因此在缩放后可以读取,但不能不缩放.
它是一个完整的物理物体或印刷设计,如象形图,而不是文字,面部,反射,阴影或叶子等类似事物的质量之一.
如果问题单挑出目标,可能出现其他同类物体.

blocks.en:
For each object, a language model writes a question and an edit instruction for each of two variants (A, B).
The question has four options, which are the answers for the original (O), A and B and a distractor.
The answers of the three versions are pairwise different, so a set tests whether the agent’s answer changes with the object.
The four options belong to one category, such as arrows that point up, up-left and up-right.
Changes of symbol, shape, direction and state are preferred over color, because models tend to assume the usual look of an object without looking closely.
The question first locates the object and only then asks about it.
It usually names a large part of the photo first and then the item that carries the object, and it names neither the answer nor a property that reveals it.
Its answer requires no reading of text, and any reasoning uses only common knowledge.
Besides questions about the object itself, some questions add one step of common-sense reasoning, such as what a sign allows, and some compare the object with an unedited object elsewhere in the photo.
Before editing, the plan is checked on the original, so that the answer for O is correct.
An image editing model then edits an enlarged crop around the object according to each instruction.
The edited crop is registered to the original, and the change is restricted to the object mask.
The result is then pasted back into the full-resolution photo, so the versions differ only in the region of the old and the new object.
For 108 sets, both variants are chosen to contradict common sense or another cue in the photo, so a guess gives the original’s answer.
Table 10 names the models of each step.
Several models propose the objects and write the questions, so that the preferences of one model do not run through all sets.
blocks.zh:
对于每个对象,一个语言模型为两个变体(A,B)的每个都写一个问题和一个编辑指令.
问题有四个选项,分别是原(O),A和B的答案和一个分心者.
三个版本的答案是双向的,因此一个设定测试代理的答案是否随对象而改变.
四个选项属于一类,如指向上,向上左和向上右的箭头.
改变符号,形状,方向和状态比颜色更受青睐,因为模型倾向于假设一个物体的通常外观而不仔细查看.
问题首先确定对象的位置,然后才提出问题。
它通常首先给照片的很大一部分命名,然后给携带对象的物品命名,它既不给答案命名,也不给揭示它的财产命名.
它的答案不需要阅读文本,任何推理只使用共同的知识.
除了关于物体本身的问题外,有些问题还增加了常识推理的一步,如一个符号允许什么,有些问题则将物体与照片中其他地方的未经编辑的对象进行比较.
编辑前,在原稿上检查计划,使O的答案正确.
图像编辑模型然后根据每个指令在对象周围编辑扩展的裁剪。
经编辑的作物注册为原作,更改仅限于对象面具.
结果随后被粘贴回全分辨率照片,因此版本仅在新旧对象的区域有所不同.
对于108套,两种变体都被选为与照片中的常识或另一个提示相矛盾,因此一个猜测给出了原件的答案.
表10列出了每个步骤的模型。
有几个模型提出对象并写问题,这样一个模型的偏好就不会贯穿所有集.

blocks.en: Table 10 : Models in the pipeline of ViRA-Bench and the number of sets that each one handles.
blocks.zh: 表10:VIRA-Bench输油管中的模型和每台设备处理的数量。

blocks.en:
Vision-language models answer each version from a crop around the object and check that the question identifies the object in the photo.
A realism check also compares each variant with the original.
These checks only flag candidates.
Human reviewers then check every question against the three versions and the object at full resolution.
They accept, correct or rewrite each question.
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型从一个围绕对象的裁剪中回答每个版本,并检查问题是否在照片中识别对象.
一个现实主义的检查也比较了每个变体和原物.
这些检查只是旗下候选人。
人类评论员然后对照三个版本和完全解析对象检查每一个问题.
他们接受、正确或改写每个问题。

blocks.en: B.2 Editing traces and the first zoom
blocks.zh: B.2 编辑痕迹和第一个缩放

blocks.en:
The three versions of a set share the question and the position of the object, and A and B differ from O only in the region of the old and the new object.
If editing left traces that showed an agent where to look, its first zoom would cover the object more often on A and B than on the unedited O.
Table 12 compares the two for eight agents in the runs of Table 1 .
As in Appendix H.1 , a zoom covers the object if its box on the photo contains at least half of the object’s box.
For every agent and budget, the share on the variants is between 2.4 points below and 1.2 points above the share on O.
Averaged over the five budgets, the difference is 0.0 points for ViRA-9B and at most 0.9 points for the other agents.
ViRA and λ = 0 \lambda=0 were trained on edited sets, but their differences are no larger than those of the agents that never saw such sets.
Moreover, 1,416 of the 1,664 contrast sets that train ViRA-9B and 1,160 of the 1,338 that train ViRA-27B were edited by Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, a different model from the editors of ViRA-Bench.
The open agents decode greedily, and in 35% to 73% of the cases they draw exactly the same first box on O and on a variant.
Editing therefore does not guide the search.
Since the first zoom finds the object equally often in all three versions, the higher accuracy on O does not come from the search either.
For ViRA-9B at 0.5 MP, the first zoom covers the object on 87.6%, 87.6% and 86.8% of the O, A and B images, but the accuracy is 73.4%, 62.4% and 59.5%.
ViRA-Bench-Real has no editing traces, because its photos are not edited (Appendix B.3 ).
blocks.zh:
一个集合的三个版本都分享了对象的问题和位置,A和B仅在旧和新对象的区域与O不同.
如果编辑时留下了显示代理在哪里查看的痕迹,其第一个缩放会比未经编辑的O上更频繁地覆盖A和B上的对象.
表12比较了表1所列8种制剂中的2种。
和附录H.1一样,如果照片上的盒子至少包含一半的盒子,缩放会覆盖物体。
对于每个代理和预算,在变体上的份额介于以下2.4点和O上的份额1.2点之间.
按五个预算的平均数计算,VIRA-9B的差额为0.0点,其他代理人的差额最多为0.9点。
VIRA和QQ=0\lambda=0曾接受过编辑器集的培训,但其差异并不大于从未见过这种器集的代理器.
此外,1,664对对比中1,416对VIRA-9B号列车的列车和1,338对VIRA-27B号列车的1,160对对比中1,160对是由Quen-Image-Edit-2511编辑的,与VIRA-Bench的编辑不同.
开放的特工贪婪地解码,在35%到73%的案例中,他们在O和一个变体上画了完全相同的第一个盒子.
因此,编辑并不指导搜索。
由于第一个缩放器在所有三个版本中都同样频繁地发现对象,O上的更高精度也并非来自搜索.
对于0.5 MP的VIRA-9B,第一个缩放覆盖对象为87.6%,87.6%和86.8%的O,A和B图像,但精确度为73.4%,62.4%和59.5%.
ViRA-Bench-Real没有编辑痕迹,因为其照片没有编辑(附录B.3 ).

blocks.en: B.3 ViRA-Bench-Real
blocks.zh: B.3 维拉-本奇-雷亚尔

blocks.en:
ViRA-Bench-Real contains 78 sets of three photos each, 234 photos in total.
The three photos of a set show the same scene, and only the object differs between them, while the camera, the light and everything else stay in place.
The objects are printed posters and signs, stickers, labels and small everyday objects, and some variants contradict common sense.
The photos were taken in classrooms, laboratories, a library and atriums of university buildings, with a Nikon Z8 camera (8256 × \times 5504 px) and a NIKKOR Z 14-24mm f/2.8 S lens on a tripod.
All photos use manual exposure at ISO 64 without flash, focal lengths of 14 to 24 mm and apertures of f/2.8 to f/6.3, and the three photos of a set share all settings.
The questions are written from the photos and reviewed by humans, and the photos carry no metadata.
blocks.zh:
VIRA-Bench-Real包含78套各3张照片,共计234张照片.
一套的三张照片显示的是相同的场景,只有物体在它们之间有所不同,而相机,光线和其他一切则保持原位.
物品是印刷的海报和标志,贴纸,标签和小的日常物品,有些变体与常识相矛盾.
照片是在教室、实验室、图书馆和大学建筑的阁楼拍摄的,三脚架上有Nikon Z8相机(8256 ×\times 5504 px)和NIKKOR Z 14-24mm f/2.8 S镜头。
所有照片在ISO 64上使用手动曝光,没有闪光,焦距为14至24毫米,孔径为f/2.8至f/6.3,一个集的三张照片共享所有设置.
问题来自照片,由人类审查,照片没有元数据。

blocks.en: B.4 ViRA-Train and the training data
blocks.zh: B.4 ViRA-Train和培训数据

blocks.en:
Of its 6,457 contrast sets, 5,329 concern text, such as the words on a sign or a label, and 1,128 concern objects.
For a text set, we detect the text in the photo, and Qwen2.5-VL-72B writes a question and alternative words.
Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 then replaces the words in the variants, and the result must pass an OCR check, a check by Qwen2.5-VL-72B and a review by Claude.
Of the text questions, 2,347 ask for reasoning about the words, for example what a sign allows.
Claude Sonnet 5.5 writes these questions, and they have answers for A and B only.
Of the object questions, 347 come from sets built like ViRA-Bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-5.4 Image 2 (Table 10 ).
For the other 781, Qwen2.5-VL-72B finds small objects, proposes their changes and writes the questions.
Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 then edits the objects, and Claude Opus 5.5 checks the result.
No ViRA-Train photo is a ViRA-Bench photo or a near-duplicate of one, such as a photo of the same series or a visually similar photo by the same author.
ViRA-Train contains no contrast set that Qwen3.5-9B or Qwen2.5-VL-7B answers correctly on every version at 1 MP without a tool and with greedy decoding, since such sets give no learning signal.
blocks.zh:
在其6,457套对比图中,有5,329套涉及文本,如标语或标签上的单词,1,128套涉及物体。
对于一个文本集,我们检测照片中的文本,而Quen2.5-VL-72B则写出一个问题和替代词.
Quen-Image-Edit-2511然后替换变体中的单词,结果必须通过OCR检查,Quen2.5-VL-72B检查和克劳德审查.
在文字问题中,有2,347人询问词的推理,比如一个符号允许什么.
Claude Sonnet 5.5写了这些问题,他们只有A和B的答案.
在天体问题中,347个来自维拉-本奇与克劳德·索内特5.5,克劳德·奥普斯5.5和GPT-5.4图像2(表10)等所建的一组.
对于其他781,Quen2.5-VL-72B发现小对象,提出修改和写问题.
Quen-Image-Edit-2511然后编辑对象,克劳德·奥普斯5.5检查结果.
无VIRA-Train照片是VIRA-Bench照片或近似复制的一张照片,如同一系列照片或同一作者的视觉相似照片.
VIRA-Train没有包含任何对比设定,即Quen3.5-9B或Quen2.5-VL-7B在1 MP上正确回答每个版本,没有工具,并且有贪婪的解码,因为这些设定没有给出学习信号.

blocks.en:
Table 13 lists the training data of ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B.
For ViRA-9B, the contrast sets are the 1,664 sets of ViRA-Train that Qwen3.5-9B does not answer entirely correctly when it views the photo at 12.8 MP without the tool.
The single images serve two purposes: they keep the agent’s skills on ordinary questions, and they show that CrossRPO can train on sets and single images in one batch.
The open questions about Commons photos were written by Claude Opus 5.5 for the six regions of a 2 × 3 2\times 3 grid on each photo and checked by Gemini 3.7 Flash.
For the multi-evidence questions, Gemini 3.7 Flash lists the objects in each region, and Claude Opus 5.5 writes questions of six types (position, chained reference, order, counting, attribute or absence, and reading combined with reasoning).
A program computes the options of the closed types from the object boxes, so that their wording cannot reveal the answer.
Gemini then checks that every object named in a question occurs exactly once in the photo.
Every single image is neither too easy nor unsolvable for the base model, which answers it correctly in at least one and at most six of eight attempts.
The training data of ViRA-27B are built from the same sources with the same rules applied to Qwen3.8-27B, which gives 1,338 contrast sets and 2,063 single images.
blocks.zh:
表13列出了VIRA-9B和VIRA-27B的培训数据。
对于VIRA-9B来说,对比集是1,664集的VIRA-Train,当Quen3.5-9B在没有工具的情况下在12.8 MP查看照片时没有完全正确回答.
单个图像有两个目的:它们保持代理商在普通问题方面的技能,它们显示CrossRPO可以在一组集和单个图像上进行训练.
关于Commons照片的公开问题由克劳德·奥普斯·5.5(英语:Claude Opus 5.5)为每张照片上一个2×3 2\times 3格的六个区域写成,并由双子座3.7 Flash检查.
对于多证据问题,双子座 3.7 Flash 列出了每个区域的对象,克劳德·奥普斯 5.5 写了六种类型的问题(位置,连锁参考,顺序,计数,属性或缺位,以及阅读与推理相结合).
一个程序从对象框中计算闭合类型的选项,使其措辞无法显示答案.
双子座然后检查,每个在问题中命名的物体在照片中精确发生一次.
每个单一的图像对于基础模型来说既不太容易也不难解,基础模型至少在八次尝试中的一次和最多六次尝试中正确回答.
VIRA-27B的训练数据来自相同的来源,对Quen3.8-27B适用相同的规则,它给出了1,338套对比度和2,063个单一图像.

blocks.en: Appendix C Agent and implementation
blocks.zh: 附录C 代理和执行

blocks.en:
This section gives the zoom tool (Appendix C.1 ), the prompts (Appendix C.2 ), the rollout loop and the CrossRPO advantage as we run them (Appendix C.3 ), and the training setup (Appendix C.4 ).
Listings , and are shortened from our implementation.
blocks.zh:
本节给出了缩放工具(Appendix C.1 ),提示(Appendix C.2),推出循环和CrossRPO在我们运行时的优势(Appendix C.3),以及培训设置(Appendix C.4 ).
清单,并缩短我们的执行。

blocks.en: C.1 Zoom tool
blocks.zh: C.1 联合国 缩放工具

blocks.en:
At a budget of x x MP, the agent first sees the photo resized to at most x x MP with its aspect ratio kept.
Both sides are multiples of 32 px, the size of one visual token of Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8, and every image has at least 65,536 pixels.
The agent zooms by calling image_zoom_in_tool with a box bbox_2d = [ x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ] =[x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2}] and a source .
The source names the image the box is drawn on.
It is either original_image , the first view, or observation_ k k , the k k -th crop returned so far.
The box is given on a 0–1000 scale of that image.
The tool maps the box to the pixels of that image, sorts and clips it, and widens each side to at least 32 px.
It rejects an empty box and a box with an aspect ratio above 100.
It then converts the box to coordinates of the full-resolution photo, using the region of the photo that the image shows.
The crop is always cut from the full-resolution photo, so a crop of a crop loses no resolution.
A crop larger than the budget is shrunk to x x MP.
A smaller crop is enlarged until it fills the budget, but by at most 4 × 4\times per side.
Listing gives the code.
blocks.zh:
在xx MP的预算上,代理商首先看到照片大小调整到最多xx MP,并保持其侧面比.
两侧是32px的倍数,大小为Quen3.5和Quen3.8的一个视觉符号,每个图像至少有65,536像素.
代理通过调用 bbox_2d = [x 1, y 1, x 2, y 2] = [x_{1}, y_{1}, x_{2}, y_{2}] 和源来缩放图像 。
源名称为框绘制的图像 。
它要么是原始的_图像,第一视图,要么是观察_kk, kk-th作物至今返回.
该框以该图像的0-1 000比例表示。
工具将盒子映射到图像的像素,排序和剪辑,将每个侧面扩大至至少32px.
它拒绝一个空框和一个宽比超过100的框.
然后它利用图像显示的照片区域,将盒子转换成全分辨率照片的坐标.
作物总是从全分辨率照片中切除,因此作物的作物没有失去分辨率.
大于预算的作物缩水为xx MP.
面积较小的作物扩大,直到预算满额,但每边最多增加4×4×次。
列表给出代码.

blocks.en: C.2 Prompts
blocks.zh: C.2 提示

blocks.en:
The system prompt (Listing ) is the prompt of DeepEyes [ 87 ] with three additions.
The box description states the 0–1000 scale, the tool takes the source parameter, and two sentences ask the agent to zoom in step by step.
The first user turn holds the first view, the question with its lettered options and the answer format of DeepEyes (Listing ).
After each zoom, the next user turn holds the crop and names it.
It then suggests how to go on and asks the question again.
A failed call returns an error message, and the agent may try again within the same limit.
blocks.zh:
系统提示(Listing )是DeepEyes [87] 的提示,加上三个加法.
框描述表示0–1000比例,工具取源参数,两句请代理逐步缩放.
第一个用户回合持有第一个视图,问题带有字母选项和DeepEyes(Listing )的答案格式.
每次缩放后,下一位用户会转身持有裁剪并命名.
然后建议如何继续,再次提出问题。
一个失败的调用返回一个错误消息,代理商可以在相同的限度内再次尝试.

blocks.en: C.3 Rollout and advantage
blocks.zh: C.3 推出和优势

blocks.en:
A rollout allows six tool calls, and a seventh call ends it without an answer (Listing ).
A reply with an <answer> span ends the rollout, and so does a reply without a tool call.
The answer is the text of the last <answer> span.
For a multiple-choice question, it is the option letter at the start of that span.
Each reply has at most 4,096 new tokens in training and in evaluation.
The models run with thinking disabled and write their reasoning inside <think> tags, as the prompt asks.
Listing computes the CrossRPO advantage of a batch.
blocks.zh:
推出时允许6个工具调用,而第7个调用则在没有答案(Listing )的情况下结束.
用 " 答复 " 的回答结束推出,没有工具呼叫的回答也是如此。
答案是最后一个 " 答案 " 跨度的文字。
对于一个多选题,它是该跨度开始时的选项字母.
每项答复在培训和评价方面最多有4 096个新标志。
模型运行时思维被禁用,并将推理写在“思考”标签中,如提示者所要求。
上市计算一个批次的CrossRPO优势.

blocks.en: C.4 Training and compute
blocks.zh: C.4 培训和计算

blocks.en:
Table 14 lists the hyperparameters.
Each model is trained with RL on its base model, using CrossRPO.
ViRA-9B makes one pass over its 3,642 items (227 steps), and ViRA-27B makes one pass over its 3,401 items (212 steps).
Every step samples 16 items, draws one budget per item and generates 12 rollouts per item with vLLM, split evenly over its versions.
The advantages of Eq. ( 5 ) are computed per set and divided by their root mean square over the batch, and the policy is updated once per step.
Open answers are judged by GPT-4o against the reference answer with the prompt of Mini-o3 [ 33 ] (Listing ).
We use the last checkpoint of each run.

表14列出了超参数。
每个模型都在其基模型上用RL进行训练,使用CrossRPO.
VIRA-9B使3 642件(227步)通过,VIRA-27B使3 401件(212步)通过。
每一步抽查16项,每项抽取1项预算,每项产生12项vLLM,其版本均匀分布.
Eq. (5) 的优点按每套计算,按其根平均方块划分,并按每步骤更新一次政策。
开放的答案由GPT-4o在Mini-o3[33] (Listing )的提示下,根据参考答案进行判断.
我们使用每个跑的最后一个检查站。

blocks.en: Appendix E Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 附录E 评价协议

blocks.en:
At a budget of x x MP, the first view is the photo resized to at most x x MP with its aspect ratio kept, and every crop is also resized to at most x x MP.
A model’s maximum is the largest input it accepts: 16.8 MP for Qwen3.5, Qwen3.8 and Qwen3-VL and the models trained from them, 12.8 MP for models based on Qwen2.5-VL, 3.8 MP for Claude Haiku 5.5 and 30.7 MP for GPT-6-Luna.
Budgets above a model’s maximum use the maximum.
blocks.zh:
在xx MP的预算上,第一个视图是照片大小调整到最多xx MP,并保持其侧面比,每个作物也被调整到最多xx MP.
一个模型的最大输入量是它接受的最大输入量:Quen3.5,Quen3.8和Quen3-VL的16.8 MP及其培训的模型,基于Quen2.5-VL的12.8 MP,基于Claude Haiku 5.5的3.8 MP和GPT-6-Luna的30.7 MP.
超过模型的预算最大使用上限 。

blocks.en:
Every model in our study zooms by drawing a box, and the box is mapped to the full-resolution photo.
The tools differ in where the box may be drawn, in how the crop is resized and in how many calls are allowed.
ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B use our zoom tool (Appendix C.1 ).
It accepts a box on the photo or on an earlier crop, cuts the region from the full-resolution photo and enlarges it by up to 4 × 4\times within the budget, so a small object fills more of the returned image.
A model may call it up to six times.
The proprietary models call the same tool through the function calling of their APIs, with one difference.
Their crops are shrunk to fit the budget but not enlarged.
The + tool baselines (Qwen3.5-9B, ZwZ2-9B, Vision-OPD-9B, Qwen3.8-27B and ZwZ2-27B) use a zoom tool in the format of DeepEyes [ 87 ] .
It accepts a box on the photo and returns the crop resized to the budget without magnification.
A model may call it up to six times, and each reply has at most 2,048 tokens.
The released agents use the tools, prompts and turn limits they were trained with: DeepEyes, DeepEyesV2, Thyme, Pixel Reasoner and Mini-o3 (32 turns) call their own crop or code tools, and ZoomEye [ 57 ] searches a tree of crops without training.
LBS-27B [ 78 ] crops with a text action, at most three times, at its highest reasoning effort.
SenseNova-MARS-32B [ 9 ] has a crop tool and two search tools.
We run it offline, so its searches return no results.
It may call tools for six turns and must then answer, although its own evaluation allows ten.
blocks.zh:
我们研究中的每个模型都通过绘制一个盒子来放大,这个盒子被映射到全分辨率的照片上.
有关工具在方框的绘制地点、作物的调整方式和允许打多少电话方面各不相同。

The 987 sets with three versions keep the original, and the 677 sets with two versions keep variant A, since their questions have answers for A and B only (Appendix B.4 ).
The single images are unchanged, so the run has as many training items and steps as ViRA-9B.

它不在表3中,附录G.4提供了结果。

blocks.en: G.2 Zoom-box size on ViRA-Bench-Real
blocks.zh: G.2 ViRA- Bench- Real 上的缩放框大小

blocks.en:
On ViRA-Bench-Real, the pooled RLOO ablation is ahead of ViRA-9B at every budget below the maximum resolution (Table 3 ), although it is behind on ViRA-Bench.
Its zoom behavior explains the difference.
Both agents put the object inside their last zoom on about 95% of the images.
However, ViRA-9B almost always zooms once, with a box of about 1.1 to 1.5 MP of the photo regardless of the size of the object.
In contrast, the ablation draws boxes of 0.3 to 0.7 MP and zooms again more often.
At 0.5 MP, the object’s longer side therefore spans a median of 24 px in ViRA-9B’s last view and 32 px in the ablation’s.
When the object has the same size in the last view, the two agents are equally accurate.
On ViRA-Bench, the objects are larger (a longer side of 10 px at 1 MP instead of 6 px), so their longer side still spans a median of 36 px in ViRA-9B’s last view at 0.5 MP, and the gap between the two agents disappears.
blocks.zh:
在VIRA-Bench-Real上,集合的RLOO膨胀在VIRA-9B的每一个预算低于最大分辨率(表3),尽管在VIRA-Bench上落后.
它的放大行为解释了区别.
两个特工都把物体放进他们最后的缩放中,大约95%的图像上.
然而,VIRA-9B几乎总是缩放一次,无论物体大小,都有一个约1.1到1.5MP的照片盒.
与此相对照的是,膨胀画出的盒子为0.3到0.7 MP,并且更频繁地缩放.
因此,在0.5 MP时,该物体的更长的侧面在VIRA-9B最后视图中横跨24px的中位数,在斜面上横跨32px。
当对象在上一个视图中大小相同时,两个代理同样准确.
在VIRA-Bench上,物体体积较大(10px在1 MP而不是6px的更长侧面),因此其更长的侧面在VIRA-9B最后0.5 MP的视图中仍然横跨36px的中位数,两个特工之间的间隙消失.

blocks.en:
To test this, we enlarged every zoom box of the ablation around its center, which keeps the object inside the box.
We evaluated the result on 128 photographed sets, the 78 sets of ViRA-Bench-Real and 50 further sets shot in the same way, with three runs each.
Doubling the box area lowers its set accuracy at 0.5, 1 and 2 MP from 40.4 / 52.6 / 66.7 to 33.1 / 44.5 / 58.1.
This is close to ViRA-9B (30.5 / 42.4 / 53.9).
Quadrupling the box area gives 18.5 / 39.8 / 56.8.
Shrinking ViRA-9B’s boxes around their centers does not help, because the smaller box often cuts the object off.
blocks.zh:
为了测试这个,我们放大了每个放大箱 围绕它的中心, 它把物体留在盒子里。
我们以同样的方式评估了128套照片、78套VIRA-Bench-Real和50套照片的结果,每套3次。
箱区翻倍后,其组装精度从40.4/ 52.6/ 66.7降至33.1/ 44.5/ 58.1。
这接近VIRA-9B(30.5 / 42.4 / 53.9).
四方箱区给出18.5 / 39.8 / 56.8.
将VIRA-9B的盒子压在中心周围并没有什么用, 因为较小的盒子常常会切断物体。

blocks.en:
The per-version GRPO ablation shows the same effect.
It is ahead of ViRA-9B up to 4 MP on ViRA-Bench-Real and at 0.5 and 1 MP on ViRA-Bench (Table 3 ).
This agent zooms 2.0 to 2.7 times per image, and its last box covers a median of 0.05 to 0.23 MP of the photo.
At 0.5 MP on ViRA-Bench-Real, the object’s longer side spans a median of 49 px in its largest view that contains the object, twice the 24 px of ViRA-9B.
The additional zooms cost tokens: on ViRA-Bench it uses 27K to 233K tokens per set, against 12K to 147K for ViRA-9B (Table 17 ).
Its small boxes also miss the object more often.
On ViRA-Bench, at least one of its zooms covers the object on 84.5% to 92.1% of the images, against 88.4% to 97.0% for ViRA-9B, and it is behind ViRA-9B from 2 MP on.
At half the area, coverage falls from 95% to 78%.
However, on the images where the smaller box still covers the object, accuracy rises from 61% to 72% at 0.5 MP.
The low-budget gap on ViRA-Bench-Real is thus a matter of box size rather than of reading.
blocks.zh:
per-version GRPO 促销显示同样的效果.
在VIRA-Bench-Real上最高有4名议员,在VIRA-Bench上最高有0.5名议员和1名议员(表3)。
这种剂将每个图像放大2.0到2.7倍,其最后一个盒子覆盖了照片的中位数0.05到0.23 MP.
在VIRA-Bench-Real上的0.5 MP时,该天体的更长侧面在其最大视野中跨度为49px的中位数,包含该天体,是VIRA-9B的24px的两倍.
额外的缩放成本符号:在VIRA-Bench上,每套共使用27K至233K个符号,而VIRA-9B则使用12K至147K(表17)。
它的小盒子也更经常地想念对象.
在VIRA-Bench上,它的至少一个缩放在84.5%到92.1%的图像上覆盖该天体,而VIRA-9B的缩放比例为88.4%到97.0%,从2 MP上它位于VIRA-9B后面.
在一半地区,覆盖率从95%下降到78%。
然而,在较小的盒子仍然覆盖物体的图像上,精确度从61%上升到0.5 MP的72%.
因此,VIRA-Bench-Real的低预算差距是一个盒子大小问题,而不是阅读问题。

blocks.zh: G.3 具有交叉输入权重的反版GPRO

We therefore test whether the joint term also helps per-version GRPO.

blocks.en:
On the contrast sets, the weight does not improve per-version GRPO.
On ViRA-Bench, per-version GRPO is ahead of both runs at every budget, by 4.1 to 12.8 points for λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 and by 0.2 to 6.3 points for λ = 1 \lambda=1 (Table 17 ).
CrossRPO is also ahead of both runs at every budget, by 5.3 to 8.5 points and by 0.6 to 4.4 points.
On ViRA-Bench-Real, per-version GRPO is again ahead of both runs at every budget.
Table 21 gives the general benchmarks.
CrossRPO is ahead of the run with λ = 1 \lambda=1 in all columns but one and of the run with λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 in all columns but three.
On MME-RealWorld-Lite, CrossRPO is ahead of both runs on the perception questions and overall at both resolutions (Table 18 ).
blocks.zh:
在对比度设定上,权重并没有改进过版GRPO.
在VIRA-Bench上,每个预算都以4.1至12.8分领先于每个版本的GRPO,其中QQ=0.5\lambda=0.5,0.2至6.3分=1\lambda=1(表17).
CrossRPO在每一预算上都领先于两者,分别以5.3至8.5分和0.6至4.4分.
在VIRA-Bench-Real上,Per-version GRPO在每一预算上都再次领先于两者.
表21列出了一般基准。
CrossRPO在所有栏目中领先于XQ=1\lambda=1,除3个外,在所有栏目中领先于XQ=0.5\lambda=0.5.
