The two runs zoom in different ways (Table 19 ).
With λ = 1 \lambda=1 , the agent zooms once per image, as ViRA-9B does, and uses 10K to 137K tokens per set on ViRA-Bench, against 12K to 147K for ViRA-9B.
With λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 , the agent zooms 2.4 times per image at 1 MP, about as often as per-version GRPO (2.5 times), but it draws large boxes.
On ViRA-Bench, its last box covers a median of 1.5 to 1.9 MP of the photo, against 0.12 to 0.23 MP for per-version GRPO.
At 0.5 MP, the object’s longer side spans a median of 26 px in its largest view that contains the object, against 64 px for per-version GRPO and 34 px for ViRA-9B, which zooms once.
The run uses 26K to 313K tokens per set.
blocks.zh:
两者以不同方式放大(表19)。
以QQ=1\lambda=1,代理放大每幅图像一次,就像VIRA-9B一样,在VIRA-Bench上每套使用10K到137K的令牌,而VIRA-9B则使用12K到147K.
以QQ=0.5\lambda=0.5,代理在1 MP时每幅图像放大2.4次,大约与per-version GRPO(2.5次)一样频繁,但绘制了大框.
在VIRA-Bench上,它的最后一个盒子覆盖了照片的中位数为1.5到1.9MP,而反之为0.12到0.23MP的反射版GRPO.
在0.5 MP时,对象较长的侧面在最大视野中跨度为26 px,包含对象,而反之,64 px为per-version GRPO,34 px为VIRA-9B,缩放一次.
运行时每集使用26K至313K令牌.

blocks.en: G.4 Training on one version per set
blocks.zh: G.4 每集培训一个版本

blocks.en:
Without the joint term ( λ = 0 \lambda=0 ), the versions of a contrast set are still in the training data, as separate images.
A further run also removes the other versions: each contrast set keeps one version, and the advantage is that of λ = 0 \lambda=0 (Appendix G.1 ).
The three runs form a sequence.
The run with one version per set trains on one image of each set, λ = 0 \lambda=0 adds the other versions as separate images, and CrossRPO adds the joint term.
The tables of this appendix list the run as λ = 0 \lambda=0 , one version per set .
blocks.zh:
没有联合名词(QQ=0\lambda=0),对比集的版本仍然作为单独的图像在训练数据中.
进一步运行也会移除其他版本:每个对比集保留一个版本,优势是QQ=0\lambda=0(附录G.1).
三个运行形成一个序列.
每组列车在每组一个图像上有一个版本的运行,QQ=0\lambda=0 将其他版本作为单独的图像添加,CrossRPO则添加联合名词.
本附录各表列出运行情况为: = = 0\lambda=0,每集1个版本.

blocks.en:
On ViRA-Bench, the other versions alone do not raise set accuracy.
The run with one version per set and λ = 0 \lambda=0 differ by at most 0.7 points at every budget (31.1 / 40.5 / 49.3 / 53.6 / 58.1 against 31.3 / 41.2 / 50.0 / 52.9 / 58.7, Table 17 ).
CrossRPO is ahead of both at every budget, by 3.9 to 7.6 points over the run with one version per set.
On ViRA-Bench, the gain of CrossRPO therefore comes from the joint term and not from the additional images.
On ViRA-Bench-Real, the run is behind λ = 0 \lambda=0 by 1.3 to 3.0 points at four budgets and ahead by 1.3 points at 2 MP.
CrossRPO is ahead of it by 4.7 to 10.7 points at four budgets and behind by 0.4 points at 2 MP.
blocks.zh:
在VIRA-Bench上,仅其他版本并不能提高设定的准确性.
每套1个版本的运行和QQ=0\lambda=0,在每个预算(31.1/40.5/49.3/53.6/58.1对31.3/41.2/500.0/52.9/58.7,表17)中,最多0.7点的差异。
CrossRPO在每个预算上都领先于两者,在运行中以3.9到7.6的点数领先,每集一个版本.
因此,在Vira-Bench上,CrossRPO的收益来自联合名词,而不是额外的图像.
在VIRA-Bench-Real上,赛跑落后于QQ=0\lambda=0,以1.3比3.0的比分以4个预算,以2个MP领先1.3分.
CrossRPO在4个预算中领先4.7至10.7分,在2个议员中落后0.4分.

blocks.en:
The difference from CrossRPO is on the variants (Table 19 ).
At 1 MP, the accuracy on the originals is 78.2 for the run with one version per set, 75.0 for λ = 0 \lambda=0 and 77.4 for CrossRPO.
On the variants A and B, it is 61.9 and 61.6 for the run with one version per set and 63.4 and 61.9 for λ = 0 \lambda=0 , against 68.6 and 67.2 for CrossRPO.
All three agents zoom once per image and use about the same number of tokens per set on ViRA-Bench (10K to 147K, 11K to 144K and 12K to 147K).
The two runs without the joint term draw larger boxes than CrossRPO.
Their last box covers a median of 1.4 to 2.2 MP of the photo with one version per set and 1.1 to 1.9 MP with λ = 0 \lambda=0 , against 0.8 to 1.4 MP for CrossRPO.
At 0.5 MP, the object’s longer side spans a median of 27 px and 28 px in their largest view that contains the object, against 34 px for CrossRPO.

1 MP,原版的精度为78.2,每套1个版本的运行精度为75.0 = 0\lambda=0,CrossRPO为77.4.
在变体A和B上,运行时为61.9和61.6,每集一个版本;63.4和61.9为QQ=0\lambda=0,对CrossRPO为68.6和67.2.

Table 22 gives the general benchmarks.
CrossRPO is ahead of the run with one version per set in ten of the 14 columns and tied in one.
The largest difference is on O3-Bench, where the run is behind CrossRPO by 6.6 points at 1 MP and by 3.8 points at the maximum resolution, and within 0.9 points of λ = 0 \lambda=0 .
On V ∗ and HR-Bench, the run is behind λ = 0 \lambda=0 by 1.8 to 3.2 points at 1 MP and within 0.7 points of it at the maximum resolution.
On MME-RealWorld-Lite, the run is behind CrossRPO on the reasoning questions and overall (Table 18 ).

表22列出了一般基准。
CrossRPO领先于跑步,在14列中的10列中每套1个版本并捆绑在一起.
最大的区别在于O3-Bench上,跑在CrossRPO后面以6.6分1MP和最大分辨率3.8分,在0.9分以QQ=0\lambda=0.

blocks.en:
Table 23 gives, for every model with a zoom tool, the accuracy on each version and how the model zooms at 1 MP on ViRA-Bench.
ViRA-9B is more accurate than Qwen3.5-9B with the zoom tool on all three versions, by 14.0 points on O and by 16.1 and 17.3 points on A and B.
Its last zoom covers the object on 86.6% of the images instead of 62.6%, with 1.07 instead of 1.82 zooms per image.
LBS-27B and the proprietary models zoom two to three times per image and cover the object less often than ViRA-9B.
The joint term improves reading rather than finding (Table 19 ): without it ( λ = 0 \lambda=0 ), the last zoom covers the object at least as often, but accuracy drops about twice as much on the variants A and B as on the original O.
Several models often answer without zooming.
Qwen2.5-VL-7B with the DeepEyes tool zooms on 49.0% of the images, Pixel Reasoner on 44.6%, Thyme on 18.1% and Vision-OPD-9B with our tool on 4.3%.
DeepEyesV2 zooms on 75.2% of the images, but its last crop covers the object on only 5.7%.
ZoomEye visits 21.8 crops per image in its tree search.
However, its final answer uses a crop on 35.0% of the images and the whole image on the others.

blocks.en: H.1 Error types
blocks.zh: H.1 错误类型

blocks.en:
Table 24 sorts all wrong answers of ViRA-9B on ViRA-Bench by type, and Figures 9 and 10 show examples.
A crop covers the object if its box on the photo contains at least half of the object’s box.
Most errors happen after a crop has covered the object, 78% at 1 MP and 89% at the maximum resolution.
On a variant, such an error gives the original’s answer in 63% of the cases, whereas a uniform choice among the three wrong options would give it in 33%.
In 21% of the errors at 1 MP, no crop covers the object.
At this budget, ViRA-9B zooms exactly once in 94% of the rollouts and never draws a box on an earlier crop.
Therefore, a box that misses the object or is too large is rarely corrected (Appendix G.2 ).
Qwen3.5-9B with the zoom tool makes more errors, and 16.6% of them at 1 MP give no answer, mostly because it reaches the limit of six calls.
blocks.zh:
表24按类型对VIRA-Bench上的VIRA-9B的所有错误答案进行了分类,图9和图10显示了实例。
如果照片上的盒子至少包含一半的盒子,则该物体将被覆盖。
大多数错误发生在作物覆盖对象后,78%为1 MP,89%为最大分辨率.
在一种变式中,这种错误在63%的案例中给出了原始答案,而在三种错误的选择中统一选择则以33%给出。
在1 MP错误的21%中,没有收成覆盖对象.
在这个预算中,VIRA-9B在94%的推广中精确放大了一次,并且从未在较早的作物上画一个盒子.
因此,一个错过对象或太大的框很少更正(附录G.2 )。
带有缩放工具的Quen3.5-9B会产生更多的错误,其中16.6%在1 MP时给出无答,这主要是因为它达到了6个呼叫的极限.

blocks.en:
For the five open models, a heatmap shows where the model looks in the shown image while it writes its final reply.
The shown image is the last crop that the model received, or its first view of the whole photo if it received no crop.
We replay the saved episode and take the attention from the tokens of the final reply to the T T tokens of this image, averaged over heads.
For a long reply, we use 256 evenly spaced tokens of it.
We use only the layers with full attention: 8 of the 32 layers in Qwen3.5-9B and ViRA-9B, 16 of the 64 layers in LBS-27B and ViRA-27B, and all 28 layers in DeepEyesV2.
As in [ 82 ] , we also give the model the same image alone with the request “Write a general description of the image.” and take the attention from the last token of this prompt to the image.
In each layer, we normalize both attentions to sum to one over the T T image tokens and divide the first by the second plus 1 / T 1/T .
The division removes image tokens that receive high attention under any request, and the term 1 / T 1/T keeps the ratio bounded where the second attention is near zero.
The heatmap is the mean of this ratio over the layers.
We clip it at its 99th percentile, upsample and smooth it to the size of the image, and draw it with the jet colormap, with low values left transparent.
The proprietary models have no heatmap, because their attention is not available.
blocks.zh:
对于5个开放模型,一个热映射显示模型在写最后回复时在显示的图像中的位置.
显示的图像是模型收到的最后一个作物,或者如果它没有收到作物,它对整个照片的第一视图.
我们重放所保存的剧集,并从最终回复的符号中将注意力转移到这个图像的T符号上,平均在头上.
我们用了256个均匀的符号来回答这个问题。
我们只使用全注意的地层:Quen3.5-9B和VIRA-9B的32层中的8层,LBS-27B和VIRA-27B的64层中的16层,以及DeepEyesV2的所有28层.
与[82]一样,我们也只给模型一个相同的图像,并请求“写一个图像的一般描述”。
在每一层中,我们把注意力都正常化为T T 图像符号上的总和为1,然后将第一个字母除以第二个+ 1 / T 1/T。
分区去除在任何请求下受到高度关注的图像符号,术语 1 / T 1/T 保留了在第二个注意力接近零时的比值.
热映射是这个比例在层上的平均值.
我们把它剪到九十九分之一, 放大和平滑到图像的大小, 用喷射彩色图画出来, 低值保持透明。
专有模型没有热映射,因为它们的注意力不可用.

blocks.en:
Table 25 and Table 26 split MME-RealWorld-Lite by task and domain.
ViRA-9B is ahead of Qwen3.5-9B with the zoom tool in every column at both resolutions.
The largest gain at each resolution is on monitoring (11.4 points at 1 MP and 15.4 points at the maximum resolution).
On OCR and on diagrams and tables, where Qwen3.5-9B with the zoom tool is already at 80% or more, the gains are 4.0 to 8.0 points.
ViRA-27B is ahead of every proprietary model on monitoring, in perception and in reasoning at both resolutions, by 4.7 to 8.0 points.
